title: INTERN - Project Manager — Video Production & Delivery (Entry-Level Welcome)
description:
**READ THIS PART CAREFULLY — WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR**

The single most important quality for this role is deep attention to detail — and here, that means an eye and an ear for VIDEO.

You will be the last line of quality on every video before it ships. That means catching:

\- A jerky or unnatural movement in the visuals

\- Audio that drifts out of sync with the video, or levels that feel off

\- A subtitle with a grammar mistake, a wrong word, or timing that doesn't match the speech

\- A voice that sounds wrong for the character, a scene that cuts awkwardly, a frame that looks broken

\- A file named wrong, a step silently skipped, a task marked "done" that isn't

We can teach you the tools, the pipeline, and the workflow. We cannot teach you to notice. If you're the kind of person who spots the one flaw in a video everyone else scrolled past, this role will fit you. If you're not, no technical skill will compensate.

Because subtitles and scripts pass through your hands on every video, excellent English is required — you must catch language errors on sight, not just process text.

Technical background matters, but it is second. A detail\-obsessed fresher with a sharp eye will beat a careless expert in this seat every time.

**WHAT YOU'LL OWN**

\- End\-to\-end responsibility for video production — from raw materials to finished, publish\-ready videos, across multiple languages

\- Final quality check on every video: visuals, audio, sync, subtitles, pacing — nothing ships that you haven't verified

\- Managing the video editor and coordinating their work with the rest of the production process

\- Driving the build: coordinating the engineering team so the remaining pieces of the system (dashboards, workflows, integrations) actually get built, structured, and finished — not left half\-done

\- Task management: assigning work, following up relentlessly, clearing blockers, making sure nothing stalls silently

\- Verification: confirming completed work against clear proof — never accepting "done" at face value

\- The delivery workflow on GitHub — keeping issues and pull requests organized and moving (we will train you on this)

\- Clear, concise written status reporting to the founder — accurate, specific, decision\-ready

Company: ACIS Labs

Location: On\-site — Chandigarh (this is an in\-office role, not remote)

Job Type: Full\-time

Schedule: 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM, Monday to Saturday (6 days/week), with 1 hour flexible break

ABOUT US

ACIS Labs is building an intelligent, AI\-driven video production system for global, multi\-language YouTube content. We are in the build phase — core components exist, and the work now is bringing them together into a complete, structured production operation that reliably turns out high\-quality video content at scale. Further details will be shared with shortlisted candidates.

THE ROLE

This is a builder's role, not a caretaker's role. You will help take a system that exists in powerful pieces and drive it into a complete, disciplined production operation — and then own its output.

You will carry end\-to\-end responsibility for video production. AI systems do a lot of the heavy lifting, and a video editor (working under you) does the assembly — but whether every video actually comes out right is YOUR responsibility. You will coordinate the engineering work, drive the remaining pieces to get built and structured, manage the production process from raw material to finished video, and be the founder's eyes on every detail of the operation.

You are not expected to write code or make technical design decisions — the technical direction is set. You ARE expected to drive, build\-coordinate, verify, and above all: notice everything.

REQUIREMENTS

\- A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, IT, or a related technical field (recent graduates welcome — this is an entry\-level\-friendly role)

\- **Demonstrated deep attention to detail — in your application, your projects, anywhere. We will test for this.**

\- Excellent English — strong enough to catch grammar, word\-choice, and phrasing errors in subtitles and scripts on sight

\- A genuine eye for video and ear for audio — you notice when something looks or sounds even slightly wrong

\- Enough technical literacy to read and reason about dashboards, file structures, and pull requests — you don't need to code, but you can't be lost in a technical conversation

\- High ownership: you close every loop you open, without being reminded

\- Comfortable holding others to a standard, including people more experienced than you

NICE TO HAVE (NOT REQUIRED)

\- Familiarity with GitHub, Python projects, or AI tools

\- Any video editing, video QC, or content production exposure

\- Any coordination experience — college projects, clubs, events, internships

GROUND RULES

\- On\-site in Chandigarh, 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM, Monday to Saturday

\- Personal phones not allowed during work hours. You may only access your personal phones and devices during big break hours.

COMPENSATION

Competitive, discussed at interview based on profile. Monthly payment. You are joining at the build stage — strong performance here means growing into significant responsibility as the operation scales.

**HOW TO APPLY**

Submit the following, exactly as described:

1\. Your CV (PDF format)

2\. A short written note (5–8 sentences, no more) answering: describe one specific time you caught a mistake or flaw that others had missed — in a video, a document, a project, anything. What was it, how did you notice it, and what did you do?

3\. In the subject line or first line of your application, include the phrase: "Detail is the job."

Pay: ₹10,000\.00 \- ₹17,000\.00 per month

title: Technical Writer
description:
**Job Summary**
 We are looking for a Technical Writer to join Compatio and own the documentation and content layer that
   

  

 makes our product easy to understand, adopt, and champion. You will translate complex product and technical
   

  

 concepts into clear documentation for developers and end users, while also creating marketing content — case
   

  

 studies, presentations, and web copy — that communicates our product's value to the outside world.
   

  

 This is a high\-visibility role at the intersection of engineering, product, and marketing. If you enjoy turning
   

  

 complexity into clarity — for both technical and non\-technical audiences — this role was designed for you.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 As a Technical Writer at Compatio, you will build and maintain a thorough understanding of the complete
   

  

 product suite over time. Your primary charter is to create accurate, well\-structured technical documentation and
   

  

 compelling marketing content that serves both internal technical audiences and external customers.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 Documentation Development
   

  

* Create and manage technical documentation, including product documentation, API documentation,


 technical specifications, and release notes.
   

  

* Organize and write supporting documents for products.
* Study product samples and talk with product designers and developers to understand functionality.
* Determine the documentation needs of end users.
* Work with technical staff to make products easier to use, reducing the need for lengthy instructions.
* Use photographs, drawings, diagrams, animation, and charts to increase users' understanding.
* Select the appropriate medium for the message or audience, such as manuals or online videos.
* Standardize content and terminology across platforms and media.
* Revise and update documents as products evolve or new issues arise.
* Maintain basic familiarity with the SDLC and software development practices.


 Marketing \& Content Creation
   

  

* Develop compelling marketing material — including presentations, case studies, and website


 content — that communicates product features and benefits to target audiences.
   

  

* Create content marketing campaigns to drive leads and subscribers.
* Apply SEO best practices to generate traffic to the website.
* Regularly produce various content types, including email, social media posts, blogs, and white


 papers.
   

  

* Actively manage and promote the company blog, and pitch articles to relevant third\-party platforms.
* Edit and refine content produced by other members of the team.
* Analyze content marketing metrics and adjust strategy as needed.
* Work closely with product owners and developers to ensure documentation accuracy and completeness.
* Collaborate with internal teams on product and documentation requirements.
* Gather usability feedback from customers, designers, and manufacturers.
* Collaborate with other departments to generate innovative content ideas.


 Industry Awareness \& Innovation
   

  

* Stay up to date with industry trends and best practices in technical writing and documentation.
* Suggest innovative, new\-age ideas for technical documentation.
* Adapt writing style and tone to target different audience segments — both external customers and internal technical audiences.


**Qualification Required**
* 4\+ years of industry experience as an effective technical writer.
* Experience managing documentation in Postman and Confluence.
* Proven ability to quickly learn and understand complex topics.
* Previous experience writing documentation and procedural materials for multiple audiences.
* Good written and verbal communication skills, with a keen eye for detail.
* Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Office and Word.
* Basic familiarity with the SDLC and software development.
* University degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent preferred.


**Preferred**
* Experience with GitBook or similar documentation platforms.
* Familiarity with video editing tools such as Adobe Captivate and Adobe Premiere.
* Working knowledge of Figma for visual and UI\-related documentation.
* Prior experience in content marketing, SEO, or growth\-focused content.
* Background in a SaaS or technology product company.


**What You'll Bring**
* A genuine curiosity about how products work and a passion for making that knowledge accessible.
* Comfort moving between highly technical writing and audience\-friendly marketing content.
* A keen eye for detail and consistency across documentation and content.
* Ownership mentality — you take documentation and content from concept through to publication.


**What We Offer**
* Impactful Work
* Competitive Package
* Flexible Environment
* Growth \& Learning Compatio India Pvt. Ltd.

* Strong analytical skills and proficiency in Excel

title: Consultant - Market Trading Risk Analytics (Pune/Bangalore)
description:
**About Northern Trust**

  

As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.  



  

Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.  



  

  

**Overview:**  

The Market Trading Risk Consultant will develop analytical \& reporting tools, including monitoring FX trading as needed to support Chicago trading risk management. The position entails managing market and regulatory risk.

 **Team Structure:**  

Will report to Head of Corporate Trading Market Risk.

 **Key Responsibilities**  

* Perform core daily risk management oversight for FX Trading business including VaR analysis, open position monitoring, adherence to limits, and stress scenario modeling.
* Monitor market volatility through quantitative techniques to ensure principal exposure is within firm’s risk appetite.
* Maintenance of data and providing information for regulatory reports, and internal Audit/ Compliance.
* Maintain and assist in ongoing development of metrices and analysis of P\&L attribution, regulatory capital consumption and return on capital / RWA.
* Manage initiatives, audit remediation, and regulatory projects such as the development of NT’s trading risk management on implementation and create analytical reporting.
* Assist in establishing processes, documentation, and controls to manage risks associated with FX and derivatives.
* Interpret model outputs, communicate findings, and present to stakeholders, including risk managers, capitals market team, and senior management.
* Conduct quantitative analysis to assess model performance and outcome for at top of the house


portfolio and trading desk level.  

* Collaborate with IT teams to ensure smooth integration of models and analytical tooling in existing systems and infrastructure.
* Prepare ad hoc risk analysis as required by senior business or risk personnel or as required for proposed products or services.
* Act as liaison with business units (FX Trading Desks and Treasury) and internal control functions including Audit, Compliance and Model Validation team and assist in the resolution of any audit or control issues related to FX products.

  

**Knowledge and skills**  

Knowledge of Capital Markets and financial products such as foreign exchange, fixed income, and derivatives is preferred.  

* Understanding of VaR, default and settlement risk, stress testing, and mark to market calculations.
* Familiarity with Murex Risk, Bloomberg, and reporting solutions such as Power BI, Cognos, Tableau etc.
* Experience with Excel VBA coding/building prototype risk models and reporting using Python, R, SQL etc.
* Must be comfortable working in fast paced environment with ability to make and communicate effective risk management decisions.
* Ability to articulate risk management policies and methodologies.
* Experience with the foreign exchange and derivative space.
* Excellent problem solving and analytical skills.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including presentations.
* Ability to work independently with limited oversight.

  

**Experience**:* 6\+ years of relevant working experience
* MBA in Finance from a Tier I or II college/Chartered Accountant with relevant experience
* Industry Certification (CFA/FRM) is preferred

 **Working with Us**

  

As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.  



  

Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.

Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. Our Pune team takes our commitment to service to heart. In 2024, they volunteered more than 10,000\+ hours into the communities where they live and work. Learn more.

**JOB DESCRIPTION**  

  

  

The Human Resources organization combines strategic workforce expertise, advanced analytics, and innovative technology solutions to deliver exceptional employee experiences and business outcomes. title: Sr Manager HR Shared Services
description:
**About Target**  

As a Fortune 50 company with more than 400,000 team members worldwide, Target is an iconic brand and one of America’s leading retailers. Joining Target means fostering a culture rooted in care, inclusion and respect, while striving to make a meaningful and positive impact. At Target, we value diverse perspectives, encourage authentic relationships and believe every team member’s voice matters.

**Overview of Target in India**  

Target’s success is driven by a timeless purpose and a proven strategy, brought to life by talented teams across the globe. In India, Target operates as a fully integrated part of its global organization, with more than 5,000 team members in Bengaluru supporting enterprise\-wide strategy, technology and operations. Target in India offers an inclusive, learning\-focused environment where innovation, collaboration and people\-first values enable world\-class outcomes.

**About the Team**  

Target Human Resources is recognized for building strong, high\-performing teams that power the guest experience. We bring Target’s distinctive brand to life through continuous innovation, experimentation and evolution. Supporting nearly 400,000 team members across stores, distribution centers and headquarters, HR serves as a strategic partner to leaders and team members alike. Our diverse community of people professionals works behind the scenes to cultivate a progressive culture of respect, reward, growth and opportunity.

**About HR Shared Services**

HR Shared Services is a critical part of Target’s HR ecosystem, serving as a central hub that brings together people, processes, data, and technology to deliver seamless, consistent, and human\-centric HR support at scale. By centralizing, simplifying, and standardizing key HR operations, enabling self\-service, and driving efficiency through automation and digital tools, HR Shared Services empowers team members with timely, accurate support while enabling HR partners and Centers of Excellence to focus on strategic business impact.


As **Sr MANAGER** – HR Shared Services, Pay, Timekeeping and Scheduling Team, you will enable high performance by fostering a reliability\-centered culture and leading critical HR service delivery operations for Target. You will provide strong leadership by attracting and developing talent, enabling continuous learning, strengthening operational capability, and optimizing team effectiveness.


You will play a key leadership role in advancing a reliable, digital\-first, and team\-member\-centered HR Shared Services model. This role requires a leader who can balance strategic thinking with operational discipline, lead through ambiguity, build strong partnerships across HR and business teams, and develop talent for current and future business needs.


As an HR Shared Services Sr. Manager, you will take the lead as you drive:

**Strategy, Service Delivery and Operational Leadership**

* Lead HR Shared Services teams responsible for pay, timekeeping, scheduling, and relevant HR lifecycles, ensuring timely, accurate, and compliant service delivery.
* Define and execute strategic and operational priorities that strengthen service quality, productivity, risk management, and team member experience.
* Translate enterprise HR priorities into clear team goals, service expectations, operational plans, and measurable outcomes.
* Ensure core HR processes are delivered on time, within expected service levels, and in alignment with defined policies, controls, and compliance requirements.
* Establish and continuously improve operating routines, performance metrics, process controls, escalation paths, and governance mechanisms.
* Use data, case trends, insights, and operational reporting to identify experience gaps, process risks, inconsistencies, and opportunities for improvement.
* Build strong partnerships with HR leaders, HR COEs, Product, Technology, and other cross\-functional teams to deliver consistent and scalable HR support.
* Lead and support high\-priority initiatives that improve operational efficiency, simplify work, enhance process reliability, and strengthen enterprise HR outcomes.
* Serve as a senior escalation point for complex, sensitive, or high\-risk issues, ensuring appropriate judgment, timely resolution, confidentiality, and stakeholder partnership.

**Digital Enablement, Automation and Continuous Improvement**

* Champion a digital\-first HR Shared Services experience by strengthening self\-service, knowledge content, automation, and AI\-enabled support pathways where appropriate.
* Identify patterns in inquiries, manual work, repeat contacts, escalations, and process breakdowns, and translate these insights into recommendations for content, workflow, automation, or system enhancements.
* Partner with Product, Technology, and HR stakeholders to support testing, rollout, adoption, and stabilization of new tools, workflows, and system improvements.
* Drive digitization and automation opportunities that improve speed, accuracy, consistency, and scalability while maintaining appropriate controls and human judgment.
* Support continuous improvement efforts by applying structured problem\-solving, process discipline, and data\-informed decision making.
* Ensure new and improved processes are clearly documented, effectively communicated, and consistently adopted across the team.

**Team Leadership and Capability Building**

* Lead, coach, and develop a team of HR Shared Services leaders and specialists, creating clarity around priorities, performance expectations, service standards, and ways of working.
* Build a high\-performing, inclusive, and resilient team culture grounded in accountability, learning, adaptability, collaboration, and care.
* Develop talent through coaching, feedback, career development, succession planning, and capability\-building experiences.
* Strengthen team capability in HR operations, digital tools, data interpretation, problem solving, process improvement, stakeholder management, and service excellence.
* Plan and structure resources effectively to meet business priorities, service demand, project needs, and operational commitments.
* Foster strong communication rhythms that ensure alignment, transparency, and clear ownership across the team.
* Inspire creative and critical thinking, encouraging the team to challenge the status quo, solve problems, and continuously improve the team member experience.

**About you:**

* Graduate in any discipline
* 12–15 years of relevant experience in HR operations, payroll, shared services, service delivery, or related business operations.
* 5\+ years of people leadership experience, preferably in HR Shared Services, payroll, high\-volume operations, or digital service environments.
* Experience leading teams through operational transformation, process improvement, digitization, automation, or technology\-enabled change.
* Strong problem\-solving, decision\-making, organizational, and prioritization skills.
* Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence, collaborate, and build trust across functions and leadership levels across geographies.
* Data\-informed and improvement\-oriented, with the ability to translate trends, insights, and metrics into practical action.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with a high degree of sensitivity for confidentiality and team member trust.
* Demonstrated ability to lead through ambiguity, manage competing priorities, and adapt to evolving business needs.
* Demonstrates resilience, courage, inclusion, accountability, and a commitment to building strong teams.

**Position Type** Management  

**JOB SUMMARY**


As a member of the property Human Resources support staff, he/she works with Human Resources employees to carry out the daily activities of the Human Resource Office including oversight of recruitment, total compensation, and training and development. Additionally, he/she focuses on delivering HR services that meet or exceed the needs of employees and enable business success; as well as ensures compliance with all applicable laws, regulations and operating procedures.


**CANDIDATE PROFILE**

**Education and Experience**


* High school diploma or GED; 3 years experience in the human resources, management operations, or related professional area.


OR


* 2\-year degree from an accredited university in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related major; 1 year experience in the human resources, management operations, or related professional area.


**CORE WORK ACTIVITIES**


**Managing Recruitment and Hiring Process**


* Assists in the interviewing and hiring of Human Resource employee team members with the appropriate skills, as needed.


* Establishes and maintains contact with external recruitment sources.


* Attends job fairs and ensures documentation of outreach efforts in accordance with Human Resource Standard Operating Procedures.


* Networks with local organizations (e.g., Hotel Association and peers) to source candidates for current or future openings.


* Oversees/monitors candidate identification and selection process.


* Provides subject matter expertise to property managers regarding selection procedures.


* Partners with vendor partners to ensure effective advertisement efforts are being utilized for open positions in appropriate venues to attract a diverse candidate pool.


* Performs quality control on candidate identification/selection.


**Administering and Educating Employee Benefits**


* Works with the unemployment services provider to respond to unemployment claims; reviews provider reports for accuracy and corrects errors.


* Prepares, audits and distributes unemployment claim activity reports to property management.


* Attends unemployment hearings and ensures property is properly represented.


* Ensures that department has the available resources on hand to administer employee.


**Managing Employee Development**


* Supports a departmental orientation program for employees to receive the appropriate new hire training to successfully perform their job.


* Ensures employees are cross\-trained to support successful daily operations.


* Uses all available on the job training tools for employees; supervise on\-going training initiatives and conducts training, when appropriate.


* Ensures coordination and facilitation of new hire orientation program to generate a positive first impression for employees and emphasize the importance of guest service in company culture.


* Ensures attendance by all new hires and participation of the leadership team in training programs


* Collaborates with management team to ensure departmental orientation processes are in place and employees receive the appropriate new hire training to successfully perform their job.


**Maintaining Employee Relations**


* Assists in maintaining effective employee communication channels in the property (e.g., develops daily communications and assists with regularly scheduled property\-wide meetings).


* Reviews progressive discipline documentation for accuracy and consistency, and checks for supportive documentation and is accountable for determining appropriate action.


* Utilizes an “open door” policy to acknowledge employee problems or concerns in a timely manner


* Ensures employee issues are referred to the Department Manager for resolution or escalated to the Director of Human Resources/Multi\-Property Director of Human Resources.


* Partners with Loss Prevention to conduct employee accident investigations, as necessary.


* Communicates performance expectations in accordance with job descriptions for each position.


**Managing Legal and Compliance Practices**


* Ensures employee files contain required employment paperwork, proper performance management and compensation documentation, are properly maintained and secured for the required length of time.


* Ensures compliance with procedure for accessing, reviewing, and auditing employee files and ensure compliance with the Privacy Act.


* Ensures medical records are maintained in a separate, secure and confidential medical file.


* Facilitates random, reasonable belief and post accident drug testing process (in properties where applicable).


* Communicates property rules and regulations via the employee handbook.


* Ensures all safety and security policies (e.g., property removal, lost and found items, blood borne pathogens, accident reporting, and hygiene) are communicated to employees on a regular basis through orientation, property meetings, bulletin boards, etc.


* Conducts periodic claims reviews with Regional Claims office to ensure claims are closed in a timely manner and reserve levels are appropriate for open claims.

* Manages Workers Compensation claims to ensure appropriate employee care and manage costs.

title: Sr. Manager - EHS
description:
Job Description:
**Sr. Manager \- EHS**
======================

**Role Purpose:**  

To design, promote, and implement **environmental protection, health, safety, and security programs** within the plant/unit. Ensures compliance with legal regulations and corporate standards, fosters a proactive safety culture, and supports continuous improvement of EHS performance. May also oversee **plant/site security operations**, depending on organizational scope. **✅** **Key Responsibilities*** **EHS Strategy \& Governance**
* Develop, implement, and maintain the **Unit/Plant EHS strategy**, aligned with corporate EHS policies and local regulations.
* Lead and manage the EHS management system (ISO 14001, ISO 45001, environmental permits, audits).
* Establish and maintain emergency preparedness and crisis management plans.
* Conduct regular EHS governance reviews with plant leadership.
* **Regulatory Compliance**
* Monitor and interpret **regulatory and statutory changes** related to environment, health, safety, and security within the plant/site.
* Ensure full compliance with national, state, and local laws (environmental permits, hazardous waste, occupational safety standards, fire safety).
* Interface with regulatory authorities during inspections, audits, and certifications.
* **Risk Prevention \& Control**
* Identify potential **EHS risks and hazards** through risk assessments (HIRA, JSA, environmental impact assessments).
* Implement preventive and corrective actions to eliminate or reduce risks.
* Ensure proper functioning of incident reporting, investigation, and root cause analysis systems.
* Oversee process safety management (PSM) in units handling high‑risk operations.
* **Environmental Management**
* Lead initiatives related to:
* + Waste management \& disposal
	+ Air \& water quality compliance
	+ Hazardous chemical handling
	+ Energy optimization and carbon reduction
* Track environmental KPIs and drive sustainability initiatives.
* **Health \& Safety Oversight**
* Maintain strong operational controls for:
* + Safe work procedures (LOTO, work‑at‑height, confined spaces)
	+ PPE management
	+ Occupational health programs \& medical surveillance
	+ Contractor safety management
* Ensure adherence to safety standards during production, maintenance, and project activities.
* **Training \& Culture Development**
* Promote a **proactive safety culture** through awareness initiatives and continuous communication.
* Conduct regular EHS training modules for all employees and contractors.
* Lead plant\-wide safety campaigns, toolbox meetings, safety weeks, and leadership walks.
* **Security Management (if in scope)**
* Oversee plant/site **security operations**, including gate control, visitor management, surveillance systems, emergency response, and security audits.
* Manage relationships with third\-party security service providers.
* **Performance Monitoring \& Reporting**
* Define EHS KPIs and provide monthly/quarterly reports to management.
* Analyze trends in incidents, near\-misses, environmental deviations, and propose improvement actions.
* Benchmark performance against corporate standards and industry best practices.

**✅** **Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)*** Lost Time Injury Frequency Rate (LTIFR)
* Total Recordable Incident Rate (TRIR)
* Number of Near\-Miss Reports / Engagement rate
* Regulatory compliance score (zero non\-compliance)
* Environmental KPIs (waste, emissions, resource usage)
* Audit results (internal/external)
* Emergency preparedness scorecard
* Contractor safety performance
* Security incident reduction (if applicable)


The EHG6 Manager significantly contributes to:* Employee health and safety
* Legal compliance and risk reduction
* Sustainability and environmental performance
* Operational continuity and crisis preparedness
* Strengthening safety culture and reducing accidents
* Protecting plant assets through effective security management


(External) English Qualifications:
**Skills \& Competencies****Technical Skills*** Strong knowledge of **Environmental laws, Occupational Safety regulations**, and compliance frameworks.
* Familiarity with ISO 14001, ISO 45001, PSM, HIRA, JSA, Fire Safety Codes.
* Experience in hazardous materials management and environmental reporting.
* Ability to conduct incident investigations (RCA, 5\-Why, fishbone).

**Leadership Competencies*** Strong communication and influencing skills.
* Ability to lead cultural change and safety mindset transformation.
* Crisis and emergency management skills.
* Cross\-functional collaboration with production, maintenance, HR, and engineering.

**✅** **Educational \& Experience Requirements*** Bachelor's/Master’s degree in **Environmental Science, Industrial Safety, Chemical Engineering, Environmental Engineering, or related** fields.
* 8–15 years of experience in EHS roles in manufacturing, logistics, chemical, or industrial environments.
* Certifications such as NEBOSH/IOSH/ADIS/DISH strongly preferred.
* Experience working with regulators and auditors.

### 

### **1\.** **Area of expertise:**


 Health Workforce Strategic Planning and Health Labour Market Analysis Consultant

### **2\.** **Purpose of consultancy:**


 Support the Palestinian Ministry of Health (MoH) in developing Palestine’s first comprehensive National Health Workforce Strategic Plan, including a costed operational plan and monitoring framework. The consultancy will also conduct a Health Workforce and Labour Market Dynamics Analysis to provide the evidence base for strategic decision\-making and workforce planning.

### **3\.** **Background:**


 The Palestinian health system faces significant challenges due to prolonged occupation, territorial fragmentation, movement restrictions, recurrent emergencies, and chronic resource constraints. The Ministry of Health has identified health workforce strengthening as a strategic priority to advance Universal Health Coverage (UHC) and improve continuity and quality of essential health services.

### **4\.** **Deliverables:**


**Output 1:** Health Workforce and Labor Market Dynamics Analysis in Palestine (Strategic Input to Health Workforce Strategic Plan)


 The purpose of this output is to generate policy\-relevant and decision\-oriented evidence that directly informs the formulation of the National Health Workforce Strategic plan. The health workforce and labour market analysis is not a standalone exercise, but a preparatory and integral component of the Health Workforce Strategic plan development process.


All labour market and workforce analysis will be undertaken under the strategic leadership of the Ministry of Health Policy and Planning Unit (HPPU) and embedded within the overall Health Workforce Strategic plan formulation process, ensuring coherence with national policy priorities, planning cycles, and governance arrangements, to support strategic choices and prioritization and translate evidence into clear implications for action, reform, and investment.

**Deliverable 1\.1:** Conduct a focused desk review of all relevant existing documents, including national health strategies, previous workforce reports, labour market studies, WHO and other partners’ assessments, and available data on workforce numbers, distribution, shortages, migration trends, and dynamics.

**Deliverable 1\.2:** Identify critical data gaps and guide the collection of additional information through stakeholder consultations, key informant interviews, secondary data analysis, or other feasible methods to enable a robust assessment of the current health workforce situation and labour market, with emphasis on labour market dynamics and future needs.

**Deliverable 1\.3:** Produce a concise Health Workforce and Labor Market Dynamics Analysis Report, , explicitly structured to inform the Health Workforce Strategic plan, covering:

* Situational analysis of the current health workforce stock, distribution (geographic, sectoral, public/private), skill\-mix, and competencies;
* Labour market dynamics (production, entry, absorption capacity, retention, migration, unemployment/underemployment of qualified health professionals);
* Projections of future supply and demand based on population needs, demographic trends, epidemiological shifts, and health system priorities;
* Key bottlenecks, inequities, and opportunities, with explicit linkages to UHC progress and the four strategic objectives of WHO Workforce 2030\.

**Deliverable 1\.4:** Present and validate key findings through targeted consultations with MoH leadership, health directorates, professional associations, academia, and other stakeholders, with emphasis on translating evidence into strategic implications and policy options for the Health Workforce Strategic plan.

**Output 2:** Development of the National Health Workforce Strategic plan (Primary Output)

**Deliverable 2\.1**: Design a clear, phased and participatory methodology for the development of the National Health Workforce Strategic Plan, fully aligned with the four strategic objectives of the WHO Global Strategy on Human Resources for Health: Workforce 2030:

**Deliverable 2\.2:** Facilitate structured high\-level and technical consultations with MoH leadership, directorates, health professional associations, academic institutions, private sector representatives, NGOs, and other relevant stakeholders to:

* Define strategic priorities bottlenecks, opportunities, and policy choices;
* Ensure coherence with UHC objectives and national health priorities;
* Build ownership and consensus around the strategy.

**Deliverable 2\.3:** Prepare the draft National Health Workforce Strategic plan document, including:

* A synthesis of the situational analysis (drawing on Output 1\);
* Vision, goals, and strategic objectives;
* Strategic policy directions and priority interventions;
* A realistic operational/action plan with timelines, responsible entities, and indicative costing;
* Explicit alignment with UHC dimensions (availability, accessibility, acceptability, coverage, and quality).

**Deliverable 2\.4:** Organise and facilitate national validation consultations and workshops (virtual and/or in\-person, subject to security conditions), using structured tools to collect feedback and support consensus\-building.

**Deliverable 2\.5:** Revise the draft strategy and operational plan incorporating inputs and recommendations from the consultation process.

**Deliverable 2\.6:** Submit the final National Health Workforce Strategic Plan package, including:

* The endorsed strategy document;
* A costed operational plan;
* A practical monitoring and evaluation framework with indicators, reporting mechanisms, and a simple tracking tool aligned with Workforce 2030 milestones and UHC\-related outcomes.

### **5\.** **Qualifications, experience, skills and languages:**

 **Educational Qualifications:**

 **Essential:** Advanced university degree (Master's or higher) in Public Health, Health Policy and Planning, Health Management, Human Resources for Health, Health Economics, or related field.  

**Desirable:** PhD and/or additional qualification in Health Workforce Planning or Management.  

  

**Experience:**

 **Essential:** At least 10 years of professional experience in public health and health systems strengthening; 5–10 years in health workforce assessment, labour market analysis, and strategic planning; experience in fragile or conflict\-affected settings.  

  

**Skills/Knowledge:**


Deep understanding of health workforce issues, labour market analysis, stakeholder engagement, policy development, strategic planning, and excellent communication and analytical skills.

title: HR Generalist, Technical Recruiting
description:
**About The Company**
 Kantiv is a technology company revolutionizing the way professionals in the architecture, engineering, and construction (AEC) industry manage marketing and revenue operations. Our AI\-powered software streamlines workflows, making it easier for teams to collaborate, innovate, and succeed.
   

  

 We're building a world\-class engineering organization to solve some of the most challenging AI and data problems in the industry. Hiring exceptional people is one of the biggest competitive advantages we have—and we're looking for someone who shares that belief.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We're looking for an HR Generalist with a strong background in technical recruiting to help us build and scale our engineering organization in India.
   

  

 This is a recruiting\-first role. You'll partner directly with engineering leadership to identify, attract, and hire exceptional software engineers, AI engineers, product managers, and technical leaders who will shape the future of Kantiv.
   

  

 Beyond recruiting, you'll help build the people foundation that enables our engineering team to do their best work—from onboarding and employee experience to HR operations and manager support.
   

  

 We're looking for someone who enjoys finding exceptional talent, building lasting relationships, and creating systems that scale as the company grows.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
 Technical Recruiting
   

  

* Own full\-cycle recruiting for software engineering, AI/ML, product, platform, DevOps, QA, and other technical roles.
* Partner closely with engineering managers and leadership to understand hiring priorities, define ideal candidate profiles, and develop effective hiring strategies.
* Build proactive sourcing pipelines through LinkedIn, GitHub, referrals, recruiting communities, and other creative channels.
* Screen candidates for technical capability, communication skills, growth potential, and cultural alignment.
* Coordinate interviews, manage candidate communications, and deliver an outstanding candidate experience from first conversation through offer acceptance.
* Continuously improve hiring velocity, quality, and recruiting processes through data and experimentation.


 People Operations
   

  

* Manage onboarding to ensure every new hire has an exceptional first\-day experience.
* Support employee engagement initiatives and help create a high\-performance engineering culture.
* Partner with managers on performance conversations, employee development, and day\-to\-day people matters.
* Maintain HR documentation, employee records, and ensure compliance with Indian employment regulations.
* Help improve HR processes, policies, and operational workflows as the company scales.


 Building the Engineering Organization
   

  

* Partner with leadership to continuously raise the hiring bar.
* Develop structured interview processes, scorecards, and recruiting playbooks.
* Strengthen our employer brand within India's engineering community.
* Build long\-term talent pipelines for future hiring needs.
* Use recruiting metrics and hiring insights to improve decision\-making and forecast hiring capacity.


**What You'll Bring**
* 4–8 years of experience in HR with significant experience recruiting technical talent.
* A proven track record of successfully hiring software engineers and other technical professionals.
* Strong sourcing skills and the ability to identify exceptional candidates before they begin actively looking.
* Experience working closely with engineering leaders and understanding technical hiring requirements.
* Excellent communication, relationship\-building, and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple hiring processes simultaneously.
* Knowledge of Indian labor laws and HR best practices.
* Experience working with Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) and recruiting platforms.


**Experience we'd be particularly excited about**
* Experience recruiting for AI, machine learning, backend, frontend, platform, infrastructure, or data engineering roles.
* Experience working at a high\-growth startup or scaling engineering organizations.
* Experience building recruiting processes from the ground up.
* A strong network within India's engineering community.
* Experience using AI tools to improve recruiting efficiency, sourcing, scheduling, and candidate engagement.
* A passion for building high\-performing teams and exceptional candidate experiences.


**What to expect**
 We conduct a rigorous interview process based on integrity, talent, and drive. We trust our teammates from day one and move quickly to evaluate your fit for the role. The entire interview process typically takes approximately two weeks.
   

  

 Here's what to expect:
   

  

* 30\-minute introductory conversation to learn about your background and tell you more about Kantiv.
* 45\-minute recruiting case study focused on sourcing strategy and hiring execution for a technical role.
* 60\-minute deep dive into previous hiring successes, recruiting metrics, and people operations experience.
* 45\-minute interview with engineering leadership focused on technical recruiting, stakeholder management, and hiring philosophy.
* 30\-minute culture interview.

title: Financial Analyst-MAI
description:
At Moody's, we unite the brightest minds to turn today’s risks into tomorrow’s opportunities. We do this by striving to create an inclusive environment where everyone feels welcome to be who they are—with the freedom to exchange ideas, think innovatively, and listen to each other and customers in meaningful ways. Moody’s is transforming how the world sees risk. As a global leader in ratings and integrated risk assessment, we’re advancing AI to move from insight to action—enabling intelligence that not only understands complexity but responds to it. We decode risk to unlock opportunity, helping our clients navigate uncertainty with clarity, speed, and confidence.


If you are excited about this opportunity but do not meet every single requirement, please apply! You still may be a great fit for this role or other open roles. We are seeking candidates who model our values: invest in every relationship, lead with curiosity, champion diverse perspectives, turn inputs into actions, and uphold trust through integrity.


**Skills and Competencies**

* 0–2 years of experience in financial statement analysis, with a strong interest in capital markets and financial research
* Solid understanding of company filings such as 10K, annual, and quarterly reports, with the ability to perform effective secondary research
* Proficiency in extracting insights from financial statements, supported by strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Strong attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple priorities independently while maintaining accuracy.\\
* Advanced working knowledge of Microsoft Excel (e.g., pivot tables, lookups) and MS Office tools.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively in a global team environment.

**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in Commerce (B.Com), Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field from a reputable institute, or MBA (Fresher)
* Candidates who have cleared CFA Level 1 or are currently pursuing CFA are preferred

**Responsibilities**

* Analyze and extract key financial data, insights, and disclosures from publicly available corporate filings.
* Review and interpret core financial statements, including Income Statements, Balance Sheets, and Cash Flow Statements across multiple geographies
* Apply knowledge of US GAAP, local GAAP, and/or IFRS to ensure accurate data interpretation and standardization
* Perform thorough quality checks on deliverables to ensure high levels of accuracy and consistency
* Deliver timely, high\-quality outputs aligned with defined SLAs and business expectations
* Collaborate with cross\-functional global teams while contributing independently to assigned deliverables

**About the Team**


The Data Estate Operating Unit is driving a strategic initiative to strengthen Moody’s value proposition by enhancing financial data governance, accuracy, and usability across products. By joining us, you will play a key role in analyzing global corporate financial disclosures and transforming them into structured, actionable data. This role offers strong learning and growth opportunities in accounting, financial analysis, and capital markets, while enabling close collaboration with Research Analysts, Subject Matter Experts (SMEs), and global stakeholders.



Moody’s is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender expression, gender identity or any other characteristic protected by law.  

  

Candidates for Moody's Corporation may be asked to disclose securities holdings pursuant to Moody’s Policy for Securities Trading and the requirements of the position. Employment is contingent upon compliance with the Policy, including remediation of positions in those holdings as necessary.

title: Software Engineer I
description:
**Job Description**
 The Enterprise Technology Services organization partners with every part of the American Express business to power the company’s growth and innovation with trust and efficiency, and drive competitive differentiation with speed. We support the delivery and operations of technology, digital, and data capabilities, platforms, and services globally. Specifically, our team is responsible for the company’s technology engineering, architecture, and infrastructure, providing 24x7 support to ensure an uninterrupted, high\-quality experience for customers and colleagues. We also provide product management for core enterprise platforms, and lead technology risk and information security, enterprise data governance and platforms, digital product and design, and enterprise AI platforms on behalf of the company.
   

  

 Software Engineer I develops and maintains software applications, writes clean and efficient code, completes code reviews with guidance and automated testing to ensure high\-quality deliverables, debugs software components, and supports and monitors software across various environments.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Develop, enhance, and maintain software applications to support business and customer needs.
* Write clean, efficient, scalable, and well\-documented code that adheres to established engineering standards and best practices.
* Participate in code reviews and automated testing activities, incorporating feedback and guidance from peers and technical leaders to improve code quality.
* Design, build, and maintain responsive web applications using modern technologies and sound software engineering principles.
* Troubleshoot and resolve issues in software components by identifying defects, analyzing root causes, and implementing appropriate fixes.
* Support, monitor, and maintain applications across development, testing, integration, and production environments to ensure reliability and performance.
* Collaborate effectively with product, business, and engineering teams to align technical solutions with organizational goals and customer requirements.
* Develop a strong understanding of system integrations, dependencies, and platform interactions within supported business domains.
* Manage priorities and deliverables effectively, demonstrating the ability to work independently while contributing positively within a team environment.
* Leverage AI\-powered tools and technologies in day\-to\-day development activities to improve productivity, code quality, problem\-solving, and overall engineering efficiency.
* Continuously learn and apply new technologies, tools, and best practices to support professional growth and team success.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, or a related technical discipline; equivalent practical experience may also be considered.
* Foundational understanding of the tools, processes, and methodologies used throughout the software development lifecycle, including planning, analysis, development, testing, deployment, and maintenance.


**Technical Skills**
* 1–2 years of experience in software development with modern front\-end technologies, including React, Redux, ES6/ES7, React Testing Library (RTL), and Jest.
* Strong understanding of web development fundamentals, including HTML/XHTML, CSS, JavaScript, DOM manipulation, and JSON.
* Experience building adaptive, responsive, and user\-friendly web applications across multiple devices and platforms.
* Knowledge of developing and maintaining microservices using technologies such as Java, Vert.x, Spring Boot, or similar frameworks.
* Familiarity with distributed systems, multi\-tier application architectures, algorithms, and relational database concepts.
* Experience with software testing practices, including automated, functional, integration, and performance testing, as well as maintaining technical documentation.
* Understanding of Agile software development methodologies and frameworks, including Scrum, Kanban, iterative development, and user story\-driven delivery.
* Ability to troubleshoot technical issues, learn new technologies quickly, and apply engineering best practices to deliver high\-quality solutions.
* Strong collaboration, communication, and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to work effectively in cross\-functional teams.
* Familiarity with AI\-assisted development tools and the ability to leverage them to improve productivity, code quality, and development efficiency.


**About Us**
 At American Express, our culture is built on a 175\-year history of innovation, shared values and Leadership Behaviors, and an unwavering commitment to back our customers, communities, and colleagues. From delivering differentiated products to providing world\-class customer service, we operate with a strong risk mindset, ensuring we continue to uphold our brand promise of trust, security, and service.
   

  

 As part of Team Amex, you’ll experience our powerful backing with comprehensive support for your holistic well\-being and many opportunities to learn new skills, develop as a leader, and grow your career. Here, your voice and ideas matter, your work makes an impact, and together, you will help us define the future of American Express.
   

  

**About The Team**
 We back you with benefits that support your holistic well\-being so you can be and deliver your best. This means caring for you and your loved ones' physical, financial, and mental health, as well as providing the flexibility you need to thrive personally and professionally:
   

  

* Competitive base salaries
* Bonus incentives
* Support for financial\-well\-being and retirement
* Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life insurance, and disability benefits (depending on location)
* Flexible working model with hybrid, onsite or virtual arrangements depending on role and business need
* Generous paid parental leave policies (depending on your location)
* Free access to global on\-site wellness centers staffed with nurses and doctors (depending on location)
* Free and confidential counseling support through our Healthy Minds program
* Career development and training opportunities


 American Express is an equal opportunity employer and makes employment decisions without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, disability status, age, or any other status protected by law.
   

  

 Offer of employment with American Express is conditioned upon the successful completion of a background verification check, subject to applicable laws and regulations.

title: Sales & Business Development Executive
description:
**Company:** Acc\-Red

**Department:** Sales \& Business Development

**Location:** Dahisar East, Mumbai

**Work Mode:** Work from office with client/site visits as required

**Employment Type:** Full\-time

**Working Days:** 6 days a week

**Weekly Off:** Sunday

**Timings:** 10:00 AM to 6:00 PM

**Salary:** ₹20,000 to ₹25,000 per month

**Incentives:** Revenue\-based performance incentives

**Travel:** Travel reimbursement as per company policy

**Joining:** Immediate preferred

**Reporting To:** Management

**About Acc\-Red**

Acc\-Red is a fast\-growing accessibility solutions company working to make homes, offices, banks, hospitals, clinics, societies, schools, and public spaces more accessible for people with mobility needs.

We design, manufacture, and supply practical accessibility products such as wheelchair ramps and related mobility solutions. Our work serves both individual customers and institutions that want to make their spaces safer, more inclusive, and easier to access.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a **Sales \& Business Development Executive** who can handle both office\-based sales follow\-ups and scheduled client/site visits.

This is not a pure field sales role and not a pure desk sales role. The person will be responsible for handling leads, generating new business opportunities, speaking with customers, visiting client locations when required, conducting product demos, coordinating quotations, following up for POs/payments, and maintaining daily sales updates.

The role will involve working with **B2B clients, banks, small businesses, clinics, hospitals, corporates, and individual customers/families** looking for accessibility solutions.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Handle assigned inbound and outbound sales opportunities across B2B and B2C segments.
* Generate new leads through calling, Google search, IndiaMART, references, LinkedIn, market research, and local business outreach.
* Follow up with banks, branch managers, IFMs, small businesses, clinics, hospitals, corporates, and individual customers.
* Understand customer requirements and recommend suitable ramp/accessibility solutions.
* Conduct product demos independently after training.
* Visit client sites when required for demos, requirement understanding, and sales discussions.
* Capture and share proper site photos/videos where required for internal coordination.
* Coordinate with the accounts team for quotation preparation.
* Share quotations with customers and explain pricing, product suitability, and next steps.
* Handle basic negotiation and move leads towards closure.
* Follow up for purchase orders, advance payments, and payment confirmations.
* Coordinate with internal teams for smooth handover after order closure.
* Maintain accurate lead updates in CRM/Excel.
* Submit daily reports on calls, follow\-ups, visits, demos, quotations, and closures.
* Ensure no assigned lead is missed or left without proper follow\-up.
* Support institutional and corporate sales efforts when required.
* Travel locally and occasionally outside Mumbai as per business requirements.

**Candidate Profile**

We are looking for someone who can speak confidently, follow up seriously, visit clients when needed, and close business without needing constant chasing from management.

This role is suitable for someone who wants to grow in sales and business development while working with meaningful products that solve real accessibility problems.

**Required Qualifications \& Experience**

* Freshers with strong communication skills and sales interest may apply.
* 0 to 3 years of experience in sales, business development, customer handling, lead conversion, or client coordination.
* Graduate preferred, but strong sales candidates without graduation may also apply.
* Good spoken English and Hindi are required.
* Tamil language knowledge will be an added advantage.
* Must be based in Mumbai or willing to commute to Dahisar East.
* Prior experience in healthcare, medical devices, mobility products, B2B sales, infrastructure products, or customer\-facing sales will be preferred.

**Must\-Have Skills**

* Strong communication and customer handling ability.
* Confidence to speak with facility managers, branch managers, business owners, families, and individual customers.
* Good follow\-up discipline.
* Ability to handle both phone\-based sales and scheduled client visits.
* Basic negotiation skills.
* Comfortable maintaining CRM/Excel updates.
* Ability to conduct product demos after training.
* Ownership of assigned leads from first contact to closure.
* Daily reporting discipline.
* Ability to coordinate internally and keep deals moving.

**Good\-to\-Have Skills**

* Experience in B2B sales or institutional sales.
* Experience dealing with banks, clinics, hospitals, societies, or corporates.
* Experience with IndiaMART, CRM, Google Sheets, or Excel.
* Own two\-wheeler preferred but not mandatory.
* Familiarity with using tools like ChatGPT for drafting emails, follow\-ups, or customer communication.

**Products Handled**

The role will primarily focus on **wheelchair ramps and related accessibility products**, including:

* Portable wheelchair ramps
* Suitcase ramps
* Telescopic ramps
* Threshold ramps
* Other ramp/accessibility products as required

**Compensation**

* Fixed salary: **₹20,000 to ₹25,000 per month**, based on experience and interview performance.
* Revenue\-based performance incentives over and above fixed salary.
* Travel reimbursement as per company policy.

**Who Should Apply**

Apply if you are someone who:

* Enjoys sales and customer interaction.
* Can follow up without being reminded every hour.
* Is comfortable with both office work and scheduled client visits.
* Can speak confidently with businesses and individual customers.
* Can maintain CRM/Excel updates properly.
* Wants to work with a company solving a real accessibility problem.
* Is available to join immediately.

**Who Should Not Apply**

Please do not apply if you:

* Are looking for a purely desk\-based role.
* Are looking for a purely field sales role.
* Are not comfortable with client visits.
* Do not like follow\-ups or daily reporting.
* Are not comfortable working from office in Dahisar East.
* Cannot work 6 days a week.

**Why Join Acc\-Red**

* Work in a fast\-growing accessibility solutions company.
* Get exposure to both B2B and B2C sales.
* Sell products that create real\-world impact.
* Work directly with management and learn practical sales execution.
* Build experience across lead generation, demos, client meetings, closures, and relationship management.

Pay: ₹20,000\.00 \- ₹25,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Internet reimbursement

title: Product Manager - Platform (India)
description:
VectorShift
   

  

* Full\-time
* Remote


**About The Role**
 As a Product Manager, you will own the core VectorShift builder platform: the canvas, agents, integrations, and everything that makes non\-technical users able to ship real AI products.
   

  

 You will work directly with the founders and our engineering leads, and you will have real ownership from day one. This is not a backlog\-grooming job. The platform is the core of the company, and this person will shape what it becomes over the next year — as we scale it alongside pilots with several \>$1bn revenue enterprises.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Own the builder platform: Drive step\-change improvements in the builder UI/UX, lead our “text to product” experience (describe what you want in natural language and get a working workflow or agent), and own platform stability, including building out a comprehensive automated test suite.
* Lead new initiatives from zero to one: Scope and ship new products and capabilities as the platform and market evolve.
* Go deep on existing products: Take the builder, agents, integrations, and deployment surfaces we already have and make them meaningfully better: depth, polish, and completeness.
* Know the competition: Track competing no\-code AI and agent\-building platforms closely, identify the gaps that matter, and turn that into what we build.
* Run platform operations: Coordinate and execute the operational side of the product: templates, documentation, and tutorials.
* Coordinate across design and engineering: Work closely with designers and engineers to scope, spec, and ship features end to end, and spin up quick prototypes, keeping everyone aligned on priorities and details.
* Execute on tight timelines: Break work into shippable pieces, unblock the team quickly, and drive releases to completion without letting quality slip.


**Requirements**
* \~1 to 2 years of product management experience. We care more about raw intelligence and judgment than years on a resume; if you are exceptionally sharp, we want to talk regardless.
* Scrappy: you find a way. You prototype with AI tools, hack together demos, and don’t wait for permission or perfect information.
* Urgency: you move fast by default. Days, not weeks.
* Obsessive attention to detail: you will personally QA the product, click every button, and catch bugs before users do. If “roll up your sleeves” sounds beneath you, this isn’t the role.
* Strong communication skills and ability to work in high paced environments. You can write a crisp spec and run a tight process with engineers.
* CS familiarity is a plus, but not required. You should be comfortable holding your own in technical conversations with engineers and willing to dig into how things work under the hood when debugging or specing a feature.
* Experience building with no\-code tools (e.g., workflow builders, automation platforms) is a plus.


**About VectorShift**
 VectorShift provides tooling to create custom AI workflows quickly. End\-users can run and modify these pipelines using our no\-code platform, and developers can ship complex production\-grade AI chains directly to end\-users using our API and SDK. In addition to expanding our core platform, we are working with several \>$1bn revenue enterprises to pilot our solutions for specific high\-impact use cases.

description:
**Job Description Summary**
 As a Lead HR Specialist – Labour Relations, you will provide expert guidance and support to lead Labour Relations matter on employee relations, union interactions, and works committee matters for project sites and factory location, to ensure alignment with business goals and compliance with the law, policy, guidelines and collective bargaining agreements. You will advise management on labour law, regulatory compliance, and risk mitigation, ensuring alignment with legal standards and organizational values. With a strong grasp of industry best practices and an understanding how labour relations integrate across business functions, you will play a key role in shaping a collaborative, coaching \& supporting compliant work environment. Your insights into market dynamics and competitive differentiators will support the development of forward\-thinking labour tactics that enhance employee engagement, proactive support, problem solving and operational effectiveness to enhance positive, inclusive and safe workplace culture enabling People Leaders to lead with confidence and clarity. You will play a key role in negotiating, interpreting, and implementing CBAs, and will serve as a vital liaison between management and labor representatives.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Key Responsibilities**
**Labour Law And Compliance Expertise**
 Responsible for having in\-depth knowledge of labour laws and industrial relations, the Individual provides advice, counsel and leadership on employee and unions relations. Advises management on legal/labour law/regulatory issues and risk management. Ensures legal compliance and providing authoritative guidance for labour relations matter and acts as an expert resource for regulatory requirements.
   

  

* Ensure adherence to all applicable labor laws and statutory requirements.
* Provide expert counsel and leadership on employee relations and union/works council matters.
* Advise management on labor trends, risks, and strategic interventions.
* Be a strong subject matter expert on the New Labour Code \& deployment.


**Union \& Works Committee Partnership**
 Serves as a liaison between management and employee representatives, fostering constructive relationships with union, works committee, and labour authorities. Lead negotiations including Long Term Settlement, coordinate meetings, and support ongoing dialogue to maintain positive labour relations and creating Highest performing team.
   

  

* Manage industrial relations with labour union \- representatives and facilitate collective bargaining (Long Term Settlement) processes and agreements.
* Develop and implement employee engagement initiatives including reward \& recognition or employees including long service award
* Build trust and credibility with employees across levels
* Support organizational change initiatives from a labor relations perspective.
* Execute the Long Term Settlement / collective bargaining outcomes, including the wage settlement and revisions on yearly basis.


**Business Alignment \& Strategy**
 Operate with a strong understanding of business operations, aligning labour strategy with organizational goals. Collaborate with HR and legal leads to support business needs and drive effective labour relations in site establishment and learning activities.
   

  

* Collaborate with plant managers, legal teams, and external consultants.
* Provide guidance to line managers on disciplinary actions and labor law implications.
* Develop and update guidelines related to labor and employee relations for the site
* Utilizes in\-depth knowledge of a discipline and analytical thinking to execute policy/strategy
* Keeping, maintaining and providing management reports and data analysis regularly


**HR Conflict Resolution**
 Build consultation materials, manage collective agreement litigations, and lead information and consultation processes. Collect and challenge data and coordinate responses to labour disputes to resolve issues efficiently.
   

  

* Conduct investigations and recommend resolutions for workplace conflicts.
* Address employee grievances and disputes with fairness and consistency.
* Disciplinary Actions / organize and conduct Domestic Enquiry
* Represent the organization in conciliation meetings which includes participation / represent in court proceedings
* Represents the company, facilitate government visits; internal and external audits


**Required Qualification/Skills**
* MBA/MSW/PGDM in HR from an accredited university/college or equivalent with 8\+ years of experience in Industrial Relations preferably in a Labour Relations in a unionized environment in a mid\-to large sized manufacturing Units.
* Proven experience in union negotiations, collective bargaining, long term settlement and grievance handling.
* Knowledge of Indian labour laws, statutory compliance, its documentation and demonstrated experience in application of HR policies
* Experience in managing legal cases related to labour and employment matters, including coordination and follow\-up with legal counsel.
* Experience in conducting domestic enquiries and disciplinary actions
* Knowledge of New Labour Codes: Advice the management on the impact of New Labour Codes and its deployment in the business unit (be a strong subject matter expert on the New Labour Code).


**Desired Characteristics**
* Strong oral and written communication, fluent in local language.
* Excellent interpersonal, negotiation, and conflict resolution skills. Ability to work independently.
* Demonstrated ability to analyse and resolve problems.

**Relocation Assistance Provided:**

 People – Manufacturing \& Supply Chain (MSC)

**About The Role** 




 As an
 **Organisation Capability Specialist** 
 , you will support capability\-building initiatives across the AMEA region by coordinating learning programs, managing operational governance, and driving employee engagement. You will work closely with Manufacturing, Supply Chain Excellence, HR, and Learning teams to ensure capability programs are delivered efficiently and consistently.

 **project coordination, stakeholder management, and learning operations**

 **Manufacturing Excellence and IL6S**

 We are looking for candidates with
 **4–5 years of experience**

* Learning \& Development or training coordination in a manufacturing environment.

* HR Generalist experience supporting manufacturing or supply chain teams.
* Coordinating training, capability\-building, or learning deployment programs.

* Using Learning Management Systems, SharePoint, Workday Learning, or similar digital tools.
* Vendor coordination and purchase order administration.

 The ideal candidate could come from one of the following backgrounds:
 



**L\&D / Training Specialist with Manufacturing Exposure** 




 Has coordinated learning programs, training calendars, workshops, and capability initiatives while working closely with manufacturing or supply chain teams.
 



**Manufacturing / TPM / Lean Professional** 




 From manufacturing operations, TPM, WCM, Lean, or Continuous Improvement, keen to transition into a People / Capability role and grow in L\&D.
 



**HR Generalist from a Manufacturing Setup** 




 Has supported plant or supply chain teams, understands shop\-floor ways of working, and has exposure to engagement, compliance, and people\-related KPIs.

**Must Have** 



* Loss elimination mindset – foundational understanding of Lean Manufacturing methodologies (TPM, WCM, Lean Six Sigma, or equivalent).
* Strong project coordination and organisational skills – ability to manage multiple workstreams simultaneously.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management – interact with Plant Directors, SC Excellence Leads, People Leads, and coaches.
* Good analytical skills with strong Excel proficiency – heavy Excel\-based tracking and reporting.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities across markets and time zones.
* Fluent English communication – role operates across the full AMEA region.
* Collaborative mindset with willingness to learn and grow.



  





**Nice to Have** 



* Power BI knowledge or data visualisation skills.
* Experience with digital learning tools and e\-learning platforms.
* Exposure to IL6S or Manufacturing Excellence frameworks.
* Understanding of SMETA audit processes.
