description:
**About the job** 




  





**Get to know us better** 




 We are Gera Developments Private Limited (GDPL), a brand known by our five\-decade history as one of the pioneers in the Real Estate business in Pune. Innovation, transparency, and enhanced customer experience is how we have created award\-winning, premium residential and commercial projects in Pune, Goa, Bengaluru, and California. We live and work by “Let’s Outdo”, a philosophy that defines everything we do to raise the standards of Real Estate in the country.
 



 There are many ‘firsts’ that stand to our credit. Way back in 2004, we introduced India’s first 5\-year Warranty on Real Estate, that RERA mandated only in 2017\. We then introduced India’s first and only 7\-year warranty in Real Estate. In 2014, we designed and launched the award\-winning ChildCentric® Homes, which revolutionised the Real Estate sector for both, the developer, and the home buyer. IntelliplexesTM, SkyVillasTM, and The Imperium series are our other highly successful product lines. In our 50th Year, we launched yet another first\-of\-its\-kind industry initiative—Gera’s Home Equity Power—a means to provide financial flexibility to customers to meet financial emergencies.
 



  





**How the world sees us** 




 It has been an honour to be recognised as an innovative business leader, and an employer to build a career with by some of the best talent in the country.
 



 We’re the only Real Estate company to be recognised in the top 10 mid\-size organisations six times in a row by the Great Places to Work® Institute, and we continue to feature amongst the Top 50 Great Mid\-Size WorkplacesTM 2024 in India. In 2024, we have also been proudly recognised as one of India’s Best WorkplacesTM in Real Estate, and India’s Best WorkplacesTM in Building a Culture of Innovation for All. As we raise the bar on service orientation, product innovation, real estate marketing, and brand building, we are consciously creating a workplace where our employees achieve new heights in their areas of expertise.
 



  





**Our people\-forward culture** 




 How did we achieve this? By cheering for our outdoers. We care about our people, and invest in their success. We cultivate a culture of innovation, inclusiveness, high growth and rewards, inspiring our employees to challenge themselves, and besting their own past performance to achieve their professional goals and their self\-development objectives.
 



  









**Role Purpose** 




 To manage the end\-to\-end HR Operations function, ensuring seamless payroll administration, statutory compliance, HRMS system administration, and governance of all HR processes. The role is pivotal in maintaining data accuracy, driving process automation, and ensuring consistent employee experience across the organization.
 







**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Payroll Management** 



* Own the
 **end\-to\-end payroll process** 
 through HRMS (SuccessFactors integrated with GreytHR/SAPsystems).
* Ensure accuracy, timeliness, and compliance with statutory and company policies.
* Handle payroll\-related compliances – PF, ESIC, PT, MLWF, Income Tax, Bonus, Gratuity, and others.
* Validate pay inputs (attendance, incentives, arrears, deductions, reimbursements, etc.) prior to processing.
* Conduct monthly payroll audits and coordinate with Finance for reconciliation and disbursement.







**2\. HRMS System Administration (SuccessFactors)** 



* Act as the
 **System Administrator** 
 for SuccessFactors, ensuring all configurations, updates, and process modifications are executed accurately.
* Manage employee life cycle data on the HRMS – hiring, transfers, promotions, exits.
* Partner with module leads (Recruitment, Onboarding, Performance, etc.) to streamline workflows and maintain master data integrity.
* Generate periodic reports and analytics dashboards to support business and leadership reviews.
* Lead system testing, change management, and coordination with external consultants for enhancements or issue resolution.







**3\. Statutory Compliance \& HR Audits** 



* Ensure compliance with all applicable labour laws and HR\-related statutory obligations.
* Prepare and file periodic returns – PF, ESIC, PT, MLWF, etc.
* Liaise with government authorities, auditors, and labour consultants for inspections and compliance audits.
* Maintain compliance documentation, licenses, and timely renewals under various labour legislations (CLRA, Gratuity, Bonus, Shops \& Establishment, etc.).
* Drive internal HR audits and process standardization initiatives.











**4\. Employee Benefits Administration** 



* Responsible for accurate computation of leave encashment, and other benefit programs.
* Ensure accurate maintenance of benefit data in HRMS.
* Coordinate with external service providers for policy renewals, claims, and query resolution.
* Monitor adherence to company policies and ensure statutory alignment in benefits administration.







**5\. Process Governance \& MIS** 



* Drive standardization of HR processes, documentation, and SOPs across all HR Operations areas.
* Publish periodic HR dashboards and MIS reports (Headcount, Payroll, Attrition, Cost Analytics, etc.).
* Ensure timely audit closures, data integrity, and process adherence across the HR function.
* Continuously identify and implement process improvements to enhance efficiency and employee experience.







**Key Skills \& Competencies** 



* Strong knowledge of HRMS systems (preferably SuccessFactors), SAP HR, or similar ERP platforms.
* Hands\-on experience in payroll management and statutory compliance.
* Analytical mindset with strong attention to detail and accuracy.
* Process orientation with ability to handle audits and system controls.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Ability to manage confidential information with discretion.







**Qualification \& Experience** 



* MBA / PGDM in HR or equivalent.
* 8–10 years of experience in HR Operations, Payroll, and Compliance management.
* Exposure to SuccessFactors or similar HRMS is a must.
* Experience in managing HR audits and statutory interactions preferred.

 At Zebra, we are a community of innovators who come together to create new ways of working. United by curiosity and a culture of caring, we develop smart solutions that anticipate our customer’s and partner’s needs and solve their challenges.
   

  

 Being part of Zebra Nation means you are seen, heard, valued, and respected. Drawing from our unique perspectives, we collaborate to deliver on our purpose.  You’ll have opportunities to learn and lead in a forward\-thinking environment, defining your path to a fulfilling career while channeling your skills toward causes you care about—locally and globally.
   

  

 Come make an impact every day at Zebra.
   

  

**What We're Looking For**
 The Quality Assurance Analyst – Performance Testing is responsible for planning, designing, developing, executing, and analyzing performance tests to ensure enterprise applications meet performance, scalability, reliability, and availability requirements. This role will focus on identifying system bottlenecks, validating performance under varying load conditions, and providing actionable recommendations to improve application performance.
   

  

 The ideal candidate possesses strong expertise in performance engineering and hands\-on experience with OpenText LoadRunner Professional, LoadRunner Enterprise, and modern application performance monitoring (APM) tools. The role requires close collaboration with development, infrastructure, architecture, database, and business teams to ensure optimal system performance across enterprise applications.
   

  

 Experience with Oracle EBS, SAP, Siebel, Salesforce (SFDC), or other enterprise platforms is highly desirable.
   

  

**Job Description**
* Design, develop, and execute performance, load, stress, endurance, volume, scalability, and spike testing strategies for enterprise applications.
* Create comprehensive performance test plans, workload models, test scenarios, and test scripts based on business and technical requirements.
* Develop and maintain automated performance test scripts using OpenText LoadRunner Professional.
* Execute performance testing initiatives and validate application behavior under expected and peak business loads.
* Analyze test results and identify performance bottlenecks across application, database, middleware, network, and infrastructure layers.
* Collaborate with development and infrastructure teams to investigate root causes and recommend performance improvements.
* Design realistic workload models that simulate production user behavior and transaction volumes.
* Monitor application and system performance using industry\-standard monitoring tools.
* Analyze server utilization, response times, throughput, resource consumption, and transaction performance.
* Prepare performance test reports, executive summaries, and recommendations for stakeholders.
* Participate in application sizing, capacity planning, and release readiness assessments.
* Support CI/CD and continuous testing initiatives by integrating performance testing into deployment pipelines.
* Create and maintain reusable performance testing assets, test data, and performance benchmarks.
* Assist project teams with non\-functional requirements gathering and performance acceptance criteria definition.
* Validate performance impacts of application enhancements, upgrades, and infrastructure changes.
* Support production incident investigations involving application performance issues.
* Contribute to performance engineering best practices and continuous process improvement initiatives.


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
* 3\+ years of experience in Performance Testing, Performance Engineering, or Quality Assurance.
* 3\+ years of hands\-on experience with OpenText LoadRunner solutions.
* Strong understanding of software testing lifecycle and performance engineering methodologies.
* Experience designing performance testing strategies and workload models.
* Experience executing:Load Testing Stress Testing Endurance (Soak) Testing Volume Testing Scalability Testing Capacity Testing Spike Testing
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.
* Experience working in Agile and hybrid development environments.
* Excellent communication and documentation skills.
* Ability to analyze complex system interactions and identify performance bottlenecks.


**Performance Testing Skills (Required)**
 OpenText Performance Testing Expertise
   

  

* Advanced hands\-on experience with:OpenText LoadRunner Professional OpenText LoadRunner Enterprise VuGen Analysis Controller Performance Center capabilities
* Experience scripting and performance testing:Web Applications REST APIs SOAP Services Enterprise Applications Java Applications .NET Applications
* Experience with:Correlation Parameterization Transaction Management Runtime Configuration Workload Modeling Test Scenario Design Result Analysis
* Ability to build reusable performance testing frameworks and assets.
* Experience executing large\-scale performance tests involving thousands of virtual users.
* Experience establishing performance baselines and acceptance criteria.
* Ability to identify and diagnose performance bottlenecks across enterprise systems.


**Technical Qualifications**
* Experience with SQL and database performance analysis.
* Experience analyzing Oracle, SQL Server, or similar enterprise databases.
* Experience with API performance testing.
* Understanding of distributed system architecture and cloud\-based applications.
* Experience with:JIRA Azure DevOps ALM Git Jenkins CI/CD platforms
* Familiarity with containerized and cloud\-native applications is preferred.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience testing enterprise platforms such as: Oracle E\-Business Suite (EBS) or Siebel
* Experience supporting enterprise application upgrades, migrations, and large\-scale transformation initiatives.
* Experience validating performance across integrated enterprise systems.
* Experience working in manufacturing, supply chain, distribution, service operations, or finance environments.
* Experience conducting capacity planning and infrastructure sizing exercises.
* Exposure to performance engineering and shift\-left testing practices.


 Nice to Have
   

  

**Additional Skills**
* AI Skills \- Claude Code, Github Copilot, etc.
* Performance test automation and continuous performance testing.
* Basic scripting knowledge (JavaScript, C\#, Java, Python, or PowerShell).
* Cloud performance testing experience.
* Experience working with globally distributed teams.
* Understanding of SRE and observability concepts.


**Benefits**
 We understand the importance of work\-life balance and wellbeing, which is why we offer flexibility for our teams including: hybrid work, adaptable hours, Summer Flex Fridays, Focus Fridays, and an annual companywide well\-being day to promote revitalization and success.

description:
**Job Purpose** 




 The Frontline Infrastructure Support Engineer (L1\) serves as the first point of contact for infrastructure\-related incidents and service requests. The role is responsible for continuous monitoring of enterprise IT infrastructure, performing initial diagnostics, executing predefined operational tasks, restoring services using standard operating procedures (SOPs), and escalating unresolved issues to L2/L3 teams while ensuring SLA compliance.
 



  





**Roles \& Responsibilities** 




**Infrastructure Monitoring** 



* Continuously monitor the health, availability, and performance of servers, virtualization, Kubernetes, storage, backup, network, and GPU infrastructure using enterprise monitoring tools.
* Detect alerts, perform initial health checks, validate service availability, and initiate incident notifications as per operational procedures.



  





**Incident Management** 



* Log, categorize, prioritize, and troubleshoot Level 1 incidents using SOPs and knowledge articles while ensuring SLA compliance.
* Restore services where possible and escalate unresolved or critical incidents to L2/L3 teams with complete documentation.



  





**Windows \& Active Directory Support** 



* Perform user account administration, password resets, account unlocks, and basic Windows server health verification.
* Validate Windows services and escalate server or Active Directory issues requiring advanced administration.



  





**Linux Operations Support** 



* Monitor Linux server availability, service status, and system logs to identify operational issues.
* Execute approved service restarts and escalate operating system issues beyond standard support procedures.



  





**Virtualization Support** 



* Monitor virtual machine availability, health, and resource utilization across virtualization platforms.
* Perform basic VM recovery activities and escalate hypervisor or platform\-related issues to specialized teams.



  





**Kubernetes Operations Support** 



* Monitor Kubernetes clusters, nodes, pods, and services to ensure platform availability.
* Perform approved pod/service restarts and escalate cluster or orchestration\-related issues.



  





**Storage \& Backup Support** 



* Monitor storage health, capacity, and backup job execution to ensure operational continuity.
* Perform authorized backup recovery actions and escalate storage or backup infrastructure failures.



  





**Network \& Infrastructure Diagnostics** 



* Perform basic network diagnostics, connectivity verification, and infrastructure service validation.
* Monitor network health and escalate complex connectivity or performance issues to network support teams.



  





**GPU Infrastructure Support** 



* Monitor GPU server health, utilization, and hardware alerts to maintain operational readiness.
* Coordinate hardware replacement activities and vendor support for GPU\-related incidents.



  





**Hardware Support** 



* Perform basic hardware health checks and assist in diagnosing infrastructure component failures.
* Support hardware replacement activities, post\-maintenance validation, and asset record updates.



  





**Documentation \& Reporting** 



* Maintain accurate incident records, operational logs, and shift handover documentation.
* Follow SOPs, contribute to knowledge management, and report recurring issues for continuous service improvement.



  





**Experience \& Educational Requirement** 




 BE/B\-Tech or equivalent with Computer Science or Electronics \& Communication
 



  





**RELEVANT EXPERIENCE** 



* **1–3 years** 
 in an IT Infrastructure Operations, NOC, Service Desk, or Data Center Operations environment.

title: Senior Security Engineer – Vulnerability Management & Penetration Testing
description:
Truveta provides unprecedented real\-world data and real\-time intelligence, powered by a dataset built with and owned by US health systems united in a mission of Saving Lives with Data. Together, we power breakthrough medical discoveries, accelerate regulatory\-grade evidence, and improve patient care. Today, Truveta enables research on more than 130 million de\-identified patients across the US.
   

  

 Achieving Truveta’s ambitious mission requires an incredible team of talented and inspired people with a special combination of health, software and big data experience who share our company values.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 We are looking for a
 **Senior** 
**Security Engineer** 
 to drive
 **vulnerability management and penetration testing** 
 across applications and infrastructure.
   

  

 This role is focused on
 **hands\-on identification, validation, and remediation of security issues** 
 , with an emphasis on building scalable processes and improving overall security posture.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Own and operate the vulnerability management lifecycle, including:
* Continuous scanning (applications, infrastructure, dependencies)
* Risk\-based prioritization
* Tracking and driving remediation
* Perform penetration testing on web applications, APIs, and cloud environments.
* Validate and triage vulnerabilities to eliminate false positives and ensure actionable findings.
* Partner with engineering teams to fix vulnerabilities and prevent recurrence.
* Implement and manage tools for:
* SAST, DAST, and dependency scanning
* Infrastructure and container scanning
* Develop repeatable testing methodologies and automation.
* Conduct adversarial testing and exploit validation to simulate real\-world attack scenarios.
* Track metrics and report on risk posture and remediation progress.
* Contribute to improving secure development practices based on findings.


**Required Qualifications**
* 5–9\+ years of experience in security engineering, vulnerability management, or penetration testing.
* Hands\-on experience with:
* Web and API security testing
* Common vulnerabilities (OWASP Top 10, misconfigurations, auth flaws)
* Strong understanding of attack techniques and exploitation methods.
* Experience with security scanning tools and frameworks.
* Ability to analyze and validate vulnerabilities in real\-world systems.
* Familiarity with cloud environments (Azure preferred).


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with automating security testing in CI/CD pipelines.
* Familiarity with container and Kubernetes security.
* Experience with bug bounty or red teaming.
* Relevant certifications (e.g., OSCP, CEH, GWAPT).


**What We’re Looking For**
* Strong hands\-on tester and problem solver.
* Ability to go beyond tools and think like an attacker.
* Focus on impact\-driven security, not just findings.

title: SOC Engineer (L1)
description:

 The SOC L1 Analyst serves as the first line of defence in monitoring, identifying, triaging, and escalating security incidents. The analyst continuously monitors security tools and responds to alerts following established procedures. Protect multi‑tenant GPU cloud with defense‑in‑depth, ensuring zero‑trust, auditability, and regulatory alignment

* Monitor security alerts from SIEM, EDR, IDS/IPS, Firewall, Email Security, and Cloud Security platforms.
* Perform initial analysis and triage of security events.
* Investigate alerts for false positives and determine potential threats.
* Escalate validated incidents to L2 analysts.

* Maintain SOC runbooks, knowledge base articles, and standard operating procedures.

 BE/B\-Tech or equivalent with Computer Science or Electronics \& Communication

Fujitsu is committed to creating a sustainable world through innovation and digital transformation, and we invite you to be part of this journey.

 The Service Desk Agent (SDA) serves as the first point of contact for information technology (IT) support needs, delivering responsive, consistent, reliable, and customer focused assistance to ensure the smooth operation of day\-to\-day activities. As the role evolves toward an enhanced customer experience, and as the face and voice for users seeking aid, the role holder represents the service experience and is essential in building trust. This role is key to diagnosing and resolving incidents, providing user guidance and handling service requests.
   

  

**Key Accountabilities**
* Technical capability Ability to support standard technical queries related to a focused range of hardware and software products, capable of using and configuring computer systems to troubleshoot and resolve issues.
* Customer Experience Demonstrates a customer\-centric approach by delivering compassionate and tailored support that builds trust and lasting relationships. Listens actively, communicates with clarity, and takes full ownership of the customer’s needs by not just resolving issues, but ensuring they feel heard and valued. Understands that every interaction shapes the customer’s perception of Fujitsu, and strives to turn challenges into positive experiences.
* Innovation Embraces change and drives progress by actively seeking and applying smarter, faster, and more efficient ways to deliver support. Recognizes the importance of staying informed about technological trends and continuously developing skills. Leverages emerging technologies such as automation, AI, and digital tools to streamline workflows and enhance the customer experience. Thinks creatively to solve problems, challenges the status quo, and contributes with fresh ideas that will help shaping the future of the service desk. Fosters a mindset of ongoing experimentation and learning to adapt to change, anticipate future needs, and consistently deliver impactful and forward\-thinking support.
* Business awareness Clear understanding of the customer's business environment, priorities, and service expectations to ensure the delivery of high\-quality and value\-driven support. Aligns IT actions with business impact, enabling proactive and customer\-centric service.
* Process Follows and suggests improvements for established service desk processes and tools to ensure consistent and efficient support delivery. Understands the extreme importance of accurately recording all relevant information and actions on the tickets, and any other relevant actions or tasks performed by the role holder on a daily basis. Avoids ticket duplication, promotes knowledge sharing, aligns with account procedures and security policies to maintain service quality.
* Problem solving Takes ownership of understanding and resolving customer issues within required timescales by actively listening and asking relevant questions. Escalates complex issues appropriately, ensuring timely resolution while continuously developing technical knowledge and diagnostic skills for evolving support scenarios.
* Security awareness Understands the critical role of security in daily service desk operations and recognizes that security related incidents are frequent and evolving. Follows established security policies and procedures, remains alert to common threats, and takes proactive steps to safeguard customer and company information. Knows when and how to escalate potential security concerns to protect systems, services, and users.
* Service Level Demonstrates awareness of service commitments by knowing the key components of the service delivery and recognizing the importance of meeting SLAs and customer expectations. Prioritizes tasks accordingly and contributes to consistent customer satisfaction through timely and reliable support.
* Team working Collaborates effectively as a supportive and a reliable team member, fostering a positive environment, contributing to shared goals and knowledge. Builds strong relationships with colleagues to enhance collective performance and service delivery.
* Continuous improvement Proactively seeks opportunities to enhance processes and tools to improve service delivery and efficiency. Embraces feedback and lessons learned to drive ongoing optimization, making sure the support keeps up with changing customer and business needs. Adheres to existing internal activities, such as Kojo and CommCell’s, to actively promote and contribute to a culture of continuous improvement.

****Job Description****
 Job Title: 24/7 NOC Operations Support Engineer
   

  

**Job Description:**
 Are you ready to be a crucial part of our 24/7 Network Operations Center (NOC) team as an Operations Support Engineer? In this role, you'll be at the heart of ensuring the uninterrupted operation of our fixed voice core networks. We rely on these networks to provide rock\-solid voice services to our customers around the clock. You'll need a deep understanding of various voice network technologies, protocols, and industry best practices.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities:**
* Round\-the\-Clock Support: As a member of our NOC team, you'll be part of a 24/7 operation. This means you'll be there to monitor, troubleshoot, and maintain network performance at all hours, including nights and weekends.
* Network Monitoring: Keep a vigilant eye on our networks, including C20/vC20, SBC/vSBC, G6/G9, STP/vSTP, PSX, Q20/Q21, DMS, E10B, Dialogic, Service Brokers, EPAP/PAPE, SONUS, Steer Shaking STI, NP Mongo, Broadsoft, Metaswitch, ITFS, Ultimaco, PSTN\-AXE Ericsson, and NGN\-Ericsson. Spot and address issues promptly to minimize downtime.
* Immediate Response: When network incidents occur, you'll jump into action, assess the situation, and resolve issues quickly to minimize service disruption.
* Documentation: Maintain detailed records of all incidents, responses, and actions taken. This documentation will be invaluable for future reference and improvements.
* Communication: Keep the lines of communication open with cross\-functional teams and external vendors. You'll play a critical role in coordinating responses to network incidents.
* Network Optimization: Work on network optimization and performance enhancements even during non\-peak hours to ensure our networks run seamlessly.
* Security: Stay vigilant for any security threats and vulnerabilities that may affect network integrity. Implement security measures and collaborate with security teams.
* Capacity Management: Keep an eye on network capacity and traffic patterns, adjusting resources as needed to ensure optimal performance.


**Qualifications:**
* A bachelor's degree in Telecommunications, Network Engineering, or a related field is ideal. Certifications like CCNA or CCNP are a big plus.
* Proven experience in operating, monitoring, and maintaining fixed voice core networks, ideally in a 24/7 NOC environment.
* You're well\-versed in voice network protocols like SIP, H.323, MGCP, and RTP.
* Familiarity with network equipment and technologies from a wide array of vendors.
* Strong grasp of IP networking, routing, and switching.
* Experience using network monitoring and management tools.
* Your problem\-solving and troubleshooting skills are top\-notch, adaptable to different technologies.
* Stellar communication and collaboration skills. You'll work with cross\-functional teams in a multi\-faceted network environment.
* You thrive in a 24/7 operation and are ready to handle urgent network issues at any time.

 Bachelors Degree

 4

* Administer GPU\-based infrastructure supporting AI/ML workloads.

 BE/B\-Tech or equivalent with Computer Science or Electronics \& Communication

title: Services Documentation Technical Author
description:
At Alstom, we understand transport networks and what moves people. From high\-speed trains, metros, monorails, and trams, to turnkey systems, services, infrastructure, signalling, and digital mobility, we offer our diverse customers the broadest portfolio in the industry. Every day, 80,000 colleagues lead the way to greener and smarter mobility worldwide, connecting cities as we reduce carbon and replace cars.
   

  

 Could you be the full\-time Documentation Engineer in Bangalore we’re looking for?
   

  

**Your future role**
 Take on a new challenge and apply your technical documentation expertise in a cutting\-edge field. You’ll work alongside dynamic and collaborative teammates.
   

  

 You'll play a key role in ensuring the creation and maintenance of high\-quality Operation and Maintenance Manuals, which include Maintenance Manuals, Parts Catalogues, Troubleshooting Manuals, Driver Operation Manuals, and more. Day\-to\-day, you’ll work closely with teams across the business, including the Project Manager, LSA Manager, and ISR Manager, as well as subcontractors involved in training activities. You’ll also manage documentation\-related activities and ensure adherence to Alstom’s standards and processes.
   

  

 You’ll specifically take care of defining and implementing maintenance documentation plans and ensuring the quality, cost, and delivery (QCD) objectives are met, but also manage relationships with key stakeholders and partners involved in authoring activities.
   

  

 We’ll look to you for:
   

  

* Creating and updating Operation and Maintenance Manuals
* Defining the maintenance documentation plan
* Ensuring the quality, cost, and delivery of maintenance documentation projects
* Capitalizing data and inputs within the central ISR repository (ILS PDM)
* Implementing processes to deliver high\-quality documentation
* Managing the documentation database (ILS PDM) and ensuring accuracy


**All About You**
 We value passion and attitude over experience. That’s why we don’t expect you to have every single skill. Instead, we’ve listed some that we think will help you succeed and grow in this role:
   

  

* Engineering University Degree or equivalent (mandatory)
* Specialization in Maintenance Documentation (desirable)
* Hands\-on experience (8\-10 years) with tools such as Arbor Text Editor, Adobe Illustrator, Isodraw, Adobe Photoshop, Adobe Frame Maker, and CAD tools
* Experience in working with S1000D standards and simplified technical English
* Knowledge of Product Data Management (PDM) systems
* Experience in the rail domain (preferred)
* Ability to work as both an author and illustrator, as needed
* Strong communication and analytical skills
* Proficiency in English; French language skills are an advantage


**Things you’ll enjoy** 
 Join us on a life\-long transformative journey – the rail industry is here to stay, so you can grow and develop new skills and experiences throughout your career. You’ll also:
   

  

* Enjoy stability, challenges, and a long\-term career free from boring daily routines
* Work with new security standards for rail signalling
* Collaborate with transverse teams and helpful colleagues
* Contribute to innovative projects
* Utilise our inclusive and flexible working environment
* Steer your career in whatever direction you choose across functions and countries
* Benefit from our investment in your development, through award\-winning learning
* Progress towards leadership roles or technical expertise pathways
* Benefit from a fair and dynamic reward package that recognises your performance and potential, plus comprehensive and competitive social coverage (life, medical, pension)


 You don’t need to be a train enthusiast to thrive with us. We guarantee that when you step onto one of our trains with your friends or family, you’ll be proud. If you’re up for the challenge, we’d love to hear from you!
   

  

**Important to note**
 As a global business, we’re an equal\-opportunity employer that celebrates diversity across the 63 countries we operate in. We’re committed to creating an inclusive workplace for everyone.

description:
**Job Requisition ID \#**
 26WD96376
   

  

**Position Overview**
 CloudOS is Autodesk’s centralized platform for delivering internal services and code to production. As the platform scales, high‑quality, developer‑centric documentation becomes a critical multiplier for productivity, onboarding speed, and operational reliability.
   

  

 We’re hiring a Senior Content Experience Designer to own the strategy and execution of CloudOS technical documentation—transforming complex platform concepts (ADF, deployment pipelines, CD‑Proxy, failover, observability, secret handling, and more) into clear, discoverable, and action‑oriented experiences that developers trust and AI systems can readily consume.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Own the end‑to‑end content strategy for CloudOS developer documentation—setting priorities, defining the roadmap, and driving measurable impact on developer productivity
* Create clear, practical developer docs including quickstarts, tutorials, reference material (ADF schemas, pipeline examples), runbooks, troubleshooting guides, and reusable best‑practice patterns
* Translate AI platform guidance into consistent, production‑ready content patterns optimized for consumption by both developers and AI‑driven tools in live products
* Build scalable docs‑as‑code systems by maintaining example repos, starter templates, and automated pipelines that make CloudOS easy and safe to adopt
* Design task‑focused, interactive content (step‑by‑step guides, checklists, hands‑on workflows) that gets developers to success faster in real CloudOS scenarios
* Shape information architecture—navigation, taxonomy, and search—so developers can quickly find what they need
* Partner closely with engineers to translate complex systems into approachable content: code samples, diagrams, YAML/JSON examples, and API/CLI references—authoring in Git and reviewing PRs
* Validate and improve docs with real users through developer interviews, surveys, and task‑based testing
* Measure what matters—time to first success, reduced support tickets, developer satisfaction—and iterate using data
* Champion docs‑as‑code best practices across CloudOS, including CI for docs, environment versioning, example validation, and localization readiness


**Minimum Qualifications**
* Experience designing and producing developer\-facing technical content for platform or infrastructure products, with a strong portfolio of tutorials, API/CLI references, and examples
* Deep expertise in content design and information architecture for complex technical systems, including breaking down end‑to‑end workflows into clear, usable steps
* Hands‑on experience with docs‑as‑code practices, including Git/GitHub, Markdown or AsciiDoc, and CI‑based publishing workflows—comfortable authoring alongside engineers
* Working knowledge of cloud and platform engineering concepts (e.g., containers, ECS/EKS, serverless, Terraform, CI/CD, GitOps, IAM, observability) to create accurate, example‑driven documentation
* Strong developer‑focused writing skills—clear instructions, meaningful examples, and actionable troubleshooting. Portfolio required
* Experience validating content with users, using usability feedback and metrics to drive continuous improvement
* Strong collaboration skills, working effectively across engineering, product, security, operations, and AI teams
* Comfort working independently and operating in ambiguity, driving content work end‑to‑end from discovery through delivery and measurement
* Learning agility—ability to quickly adopt Autodesk‑approved AI‑assisted authoring tools and use them responsibly within established governance


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Familiarity with Application Definition Files (ADF) or similar declarative infrastructure descriptions (YAML/JSON, Jsonnet)
* Basic prototyping skills for interactive docs (Playgrounds, sandboxes) or experience integrating docs with CI to validate example code
* Background in UX writing or content strategy in developer tools or platform engineering

description:
We are looking for a detail\-oriented and proactive **Apprentice – Global Benefits Operations** to support the handling of employee **benefit\-related cases** across countries supported by Aon. The role will involve reviewing, processing, tracking, and resolving benefits queries and transactions in line with defined processes, service level agreements, and country\-specific requirements. Aon supports multinational organizations with globally aligned and locally relevant benefits strategies across countries, making accuracy, responsiveness, and process discipline especially important in this type of work.


This internship is ideal for someone who is eager to build experience in **global HR operations**, **benefits administration**, case handling, stakeholder coordination, and service delivery within a fast\-paced environment.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Support the end\-to\-end handling of **employee benefits cases** for countries supported by Aon.
* Review incoming requests related to benefits and ensure cases are categorized, assigned, and processed accurately.
* Respond to employee, manager, and stakeholder queries related to benefits within agreed timelines.
* Validate case details and supporting documentation before processing.
* Maintain accurate records in HR systems, case management tools, and trackers.
* Follow country\-specific process guidelines, benefit eligibility rules, and documentation requirements.
* Escalate complex, high\-risk, or out\-of\-scope cases to the appropriate team or supervisor.
* Coordinate with internal teams, vendors, and stakeholders to support case resolution.
* Monitor pending cases and follow up to ensure timely closure.
* Support service delivery by adhering to defined **SLA**, quality, and compliance requirements.
* Identify recurring issues, process gaps, and opportunities for improvement, and share observations with the team.
* Assist in preparing reports, dashboards, and status updates related to benefits case volumes and trends.
* Maintain confidentiality of employee and organizational information at all times.
* Be available to work in **fluctuating shifts**, including **night shifts**, weekends/holidays if required by business needs.

**Key Skills and Competencies**
-------------------------------

* Strong attention to detail and accuracy
* Good written and verbal communication skills
* Ability to manage tasks in a fast\-paced, high\-volume environment
* Strong organizational and time management skills
* Ability to follow standard processes and instructions carefully
* Basic analytical and problem\-solving skills
* Customer/service\-oriented mindset
* Ability to work collaboratively with global teams
* Willingness to learn country\-specific benefits processes and policies
* Flexibility to work in rotating shifts, including night shift

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Graduate / final\-year student / recent graduate in **Human Resources, Business Administration, Commerce, Management**, or a related field
* Basic understanding of HR operations or employee life cycle processes is an advantage
* Familiarity with case management tools, HR systems, or MS Office applications (Excel, Word, Outlook, PowerPoint) is preferred
* Prior internship or academic exposure to HR/shared services/global operations is a plus

**Eligibility / Experience**
----------------------------

* Freshers
* Freshers with strong learning agility and interest in HR Operations / Benefits Administration are encouraged to apply

**Behavioral Expectations**
---------------------------

* Demonstrates professionalism and accountability
* Shows willingness to learn and accept feedback
* Handles confidential data responsibly
* Communicates clearly and respectfully with stakeholders
* Demonstrates ownership of assigned tasks and timely follow\-through
* Adapts well to changing priorities and shift schedules

**Success Measures**
--------------------

* Accuracy in case handling and documentation
* Timely turnaround of assigned benefit cases
* Adherence to SLA and quality standards
* Effective stakeholder communication
* Consistent process compliance
* Willingness to learn and improve continuously

**Working Conditions**
----------------------

* May require working in **global support windows** across multiple time zones
* Rotational schedule with **day, evening, and night shifts**
* Ability to support peak volumes during critical business periods
* Hybrid or in\-office support may be required based on business needs

------------------------------------

**Biltrax Learning \& Development Cell (LDC)Proposed Role: Associate – Learning \& Development**

**Objective**

To build a structured, high\-impact internal training ecosystem at Biltrax that strengthens team capabilities, embeds cross\-functional learning, and scales with the company's growth. The LDC Lead will anchor both internal and client\-facing learning programs, ensuring continuity, quality, and evolution of knowledge.

* Full\-time role

**Program Management**

Plan and schedule weekly/monthly training for internal teams

**Session Coordination**

Coordinate with internal/external trainers, manage logistics, prepare materials

**Content Creation**

Create or curate decks, training documents, SOPs, playbooks

**Client Workshops**

**Certification \& Credentials**

Design and issue internal and client\-side certifications in collaboration with management; maintain record of professionals within client ecosystems and identify opportunities to train, upskill, and certify them

**Knowledge Repository**

Maintain an internal resource bank of learning material; keep a detailed and exhaustive record of all training sessions, certifications, attendees, outcomes, and follow\-ups for both internal and client\-side programs; maintain individual LDC history for each team member to support performance reviews and define long\-term career trajectories

**Profile Requirements**

title: HR Generalist, Technical Recruiting
description:
**About the company**
---------------------


Kantiv is a technology company revolutionizing the way professionals in the architecture, engineering, and construction (AEC) industry manage marketing and revenue operations. Our AI\-powered software streamlines workflows, making it easier for teams to collaborate, innovate, and succeed.


We're building a world\-class engineering organization to solve some of the most challenging AI and data problems in the industry. Hiring exceptional people is one of the biggest competitive advantages we have—and we're looking for someone who shares that belief.

**About the role**
------------------


We're looking for an HR Generalist with a strong background in technical recruiting to help us build and scale our engineering organization in India.


This is a recruiting\-first role. You'll partner directly with engineering leadership to identify, attract, and hire exceptional software engineers, AI engineers, product managers, and technical leaders who will shape the future of Kantiv.


Beyond recruiting, you'll help build the people foundation that enables our engineering team to do their best work—from onboarding and employee experience to HR operations and manager support.


We're looking for someone who enjoys finding exceptional talent, building lasting relationships, and creating systems that scale as the company grows.

**What you'll do**
------------------

### **Technical Recruiting**

* Own full\-cycle recruiting for software engineering, AI/ML, product, platform, DevOps, QA, and other technical roles.
* Partner closely with engineering managers and leadership to understand hiring priorities, define ideal candidate profiles, and develop effective hiring strategies.
* Build proactive sourcing pipelines through LinkedIn, GitHub, referrals, recruiting communities, and other creative channels.
* Screen candidates for technical capability, communication skills, growth potential, and cultural alignment.
* Coordinate interviews, manage candidate communications, and deliver an outstanding candidate experience from first conversation through offer acceptance.
* Continuously improve hiring velocity, quality, and recruiting processes through data and experimentation.

### **People Operations**

* Manage onboarding to ensure every new hire has an exceptional first\-day experience.
* Support employee engagement initiatives and help create a high\-performance engineering culture.
* Partner with managers on performance conversations, employee development, and day\-to\-day people matters.
* Maintain HR documentation, employee records, and ensure compliance with Indian employment regulations.
* Help improve HR processes, policies, and operational workflows as the company scales.

### **Building the Engineering Organization**

* Partner with leadership to continuously raise the hiring bar.
* Develop structured interview processes, scorecards, and recruiting playbooks.
* Strengthen our employer brand within India's engineering community.
* Build long\-term talent pipelines for future hiring needs.
* Use recruiting metrics and hiring insights to improve decision\-making and forecast hiring capacity.

**What You'll Bring**
---------------------

* 4–8 years of experience in HR with significant experience recruiting technical talent.
* A proven track record of successfully hiring software engineers and other technical professionals.
* Strong sourcing skills and the ability to identify exceptional candidates before they begin actively looking.
* Experience working closely with engineering leaders and understanding technical hiring requirements.
* Excellent communication, relationship\-building, and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple hiring processes simultaneously.
* Knowledge of Indian labor laws and HR best practices.
* Experience working with Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) and recruiting platforms.

**Experience we'd be particularly excited about**
-------------------------------------------------

* Experience recruiting for AI, machine learning, backend, frontend, platform, infrastructure, or data engineering roles.
* Experience working at a high\-growth startup or scaling engineering organizations.
* Experience building recruiting processes from the ground up.
* A strong network within India's engineering community.
* Experience using AI tools to improve recruiting efficiency, sourcing, scheduling, and candidate engagement.
* A passion for building high\-performing teams and exceptional candidate experiences.

**What to expect**
------------------


We conduct a rigorous interview process based on integrity, talent, and drive. We trust our teammates from day one and move quickly to evaluate your fit for the role. The entire interview process typically takes approximately two weeks.


Here's what to expect:

* 30\-minute introductory conversation to learn about your background and tell you more about Kantiv.
* 45\-minute recruiting case study focused on sourcing strategy and hiring execution for a technical role.
* 60\-minute deep dive into previous hiring successes, recruiting metrics, and people operations experience.
* 45\-minute interview with engineering leadership focused on technical recruiting, stakeholder management, and hiring philosophy.
* 30\-minute culture interview.

title: Sr Director - SC Manufacturing & Co-Man Ops
description:
Overview:

The Manufacturing lead provides strategic and operational leadership for PepsiCo India Foods’ manufacturing set\-up, covering existing company\-owned plants and the national Contract Manufacturing network.  

The role ensures safe, compliant, cost\-efficient, quality production meeting PEPSICO standards and all the local regulatory requirements while building technical and operational capabilities, co\-driving expansion, raising the bar on talent in manufacturing team, driving continuous improvement, productivity and sustainability initiatives in manufacturing operations, driving world class operating standards, co\-leading Front Line Experience and Employee relations agenda.


Responsibilities:
**A. Company\-Owned Plants**

**1\. Manufacturing Operations Leadership**

* Lead end\-to\-end operations across operational plants, delivering volume, service, efficiency, cost, productivity, quality, safety and people KPIs.
* Drive readiness, commissioning, and stabilization for new green\-field plant and brownfield expansions.
* Ensure execution of production schedules, capacity utilization, waste control, and True efficiency/ OEE improvement.

**2\. Quality, Food Safety \& Compliance**

* Ensure 100% compliance with PepsiCo Quality Mandates, FSSAI standards, GMP, and regulatory requirements.
* Strengthen internal controls (GCS, AIB, statutory audits) and enable timely resolution of audit findings.

**3\. People Leadership \& Capability Development**

* Lead Plant Managers, and Co\-man operations manager.
* Drive capability uplift (M\&W, digital tools, operational excellence) and talent development across plants.
* Foster a strong culture of safety, ownership, and frontline empowerment.

**4\. Cost \& Productivity Management**

* Deliver cost\-optimization initiatives (MUV reduction, energy efficiency, waste reduction, automation etc).
* Manage annual manufacturing budgets and ensure AOP/forecast adherence.

**5\. Capital Projects \& Infrastructure Expansion**

* Oversee execution of new manufacturing lines and ensure delivery on timelines, budgets, and performance outputs.
* Lead the full lifecycle of the ‘upcoming green field projects’—including site evaluation, layout approval, commissioning, trials, and ramp\-up.

**6\. Cross\-functional Collaboration**

* Partner with R\&D, Procurement, PPGA, HR, Legal and Finance to drive Business, Supply Chain and People agenda
* Effective collaboration with SC verticals viz Agro, Productivity \& Performance, Sustainability, Quality \& Foods Safety, EHS, SC Planning \& Logistics and Engineering to drive Business and SC priorities.
* Represent Manufacturing in Supply Chain and Cross functional forums.

**7\.** **People Leadership \& Capability Development**

* Embed PepsiCo values and leadership behaviours across plant leadership teams, ensuring consistent culture, ethics, and ways of working across legacy and greenfield sites.
* Partner closely with HR to drive workforce planning, succession readiness, leadership pipeline development, and capability building for critical manufacturing roles.
* Champion a strong frontline engagement culture across permanent and contractual workforce, driving ownership, inclusion, and high\-performance behaviours.
* Support industrial relations stability by proactively shaping plant\-level leadership capability in people management, employee relations, and statutory compliance.

**8\. Sustainability**

* Drive PepsiCo’s sustainability agenda across company\-owned plants and Coman sites, with clear ownership for water stewardship, energy efficiency, waste reduction, and emssions intensity improvement.
* Lead deployment of sustainable manufacturing practices including zero waste to landfill, renewable energy adoption, water positivity initiatives, and resource circularity across the manufacturing network.
* Embed sustainability goals into plant and CoMan operating rhythms, capital investment decisions, and productivity programs to ensure cost, efficiency, and sustainability outcomes are jointly delivered.
* Partner with Sustainability, Engineering, HR, and Procurement to build frontline and leadership capability on sustainable operations and responsible manufacturing practices.
* Ensure sustainability standards, reporting, and compliance requirements are met across all sites, including third\-party manufacturers, aligned to PepsiCo global commitments and external audit expectations.
* Champion a culture of environmental ownership and accountability across plant leadership teams, driving measurable improvements through data, governance, and continuous improvement.

 **B. CoMan Network (Current Sites \+ Expansion Pipeline)**

**1\. CoMan Governance \& Performance Management**

* Lead operational oversight for all CoMan partners delivering 100K\+ annual volumes.
* Ensure compliance with PepsiCo quality and food safety and applicable statutory requirements.
* Drive consistency in performance through scorecards, KPIs, and regular business reviews.

**2\. Capability Building \& Operational Excellence**

* Deploy PepsiCo tools (M\&W, digital MIS, process control, quality \& food safety protocols) across CoMan sites.
* Build the technical and operating capability of CoMan teams through structured training, audits, and coaching.

**3\. Commercial, Contractual \& Governance Responsibilities**

* Oversee administration of CoMan agreements including compliance, audit closures, controls, and risk mitigation.
* Partner with Finance, Legal, Procurement, and Supply Chain to shape contract terms, cost structures, and renewal decisions.

**4\. Network Expansion \& New Site Development**

* Lead technical due diligence, project scoping, feasibility, and layout approvals for new CoMan sites.
* Oversee trials, quality validation, commissioning, and stabilization of new lines (e.g., Kurkure, Puffs).
* Enable innovation and renovation launches routed through the CoMan network.

**5\. Supply Planning \& Materials Management Support**

* Align with Planning and Procurement on monthly SIP requirements and available CoMan capacities.
* Oversee RM/PM stock controls, obsolescence avoidance, and inventory discipline across CoMan sites.

**3\. Key Deliverables / KPIs**

* AOP Volumes delivery across COSO plants \& Coman at agreed service linked KPIs (viz Schedule adherence)
* Manufacturing Lines Efficiencies and Material Usage Efficiency
* Quality \& Food safety compliance: PepsiCo mandates, AIB, internal audits
* Safety performance (viz TRIR, LTI, behavioural safety compliance)
* Cost KPIs and Productivity
* Controls and Governance KPIs in manufacturing operations
* Coman performance scorecards, audit closures, contractual compliance
* Talent development \& bench KPI.
* ER/ Culture and Org Health Score for manufacturing.
* Statutory Compliance

**4\. Future\-Facing Responsibilities (Strategic Outlook)**

* Lead modernization and automation across Company owned manufacturing \& Coman sites .
* Shape long\-term manufacturing footprint strategy, including brownfield expansions and new Coman partnerships.
* Drive sustainability agenda across all sites—water, energy, waste, carbon reduction.
* Develop a future\-ready talent pipeline aligned with global PepsiCo capability frameworks.
* Build a resilient, agile manufacturing network supporting innovation, SKU complexity, and volume growth.


Qualifications:
* 12–15\+ years in FMCG manufacturing or supply chain; multi\-site leadership preferred.
* Strong background in plant operations, technical manufacturing, CoMan/partner management, and project leadership.
* Experience in large\-scale capability building and driving operational excellence.

**Critical Competencies**

* Strategic Manufacturing Leadership
* Technical and Operational Excellence
* Partner Influence \& Governance
* Change management \& Project Leadership
* Transformation mindset.
* People Leadership \& Frontline Capability Development
* Cross\-functional Collaboration \& Stakeholder Management

title: People Generalist
description:
**Job Description:**  

  

**About ETS:**  

ETS is a global education and talent solutions organization enabling lifelong learners worldwide to be future\-ready. For more than 75 years, we've been advancing the science of measurement to build benchmarks for fair and valid skill assessment across cultures and borders. Our worldwide impact extends through our renowned assessments including TOEFL®, TOEIC®, GRE® and Praxis® tests, serving millions of learners in more than 200 countries and territories. Through strategic acquisitions, we've expanded our global capabilities: PSI strengthens our workforce assessment solutions, while Edusoft, Kira Talent, Pipplet, Vericant, and Wheebox enhance our educational technology and assessment platforms across critical markets worldwide.
Through ETS Research Institute and ETS Solutions, we're partnering with educational institutions, governments, and organizations globally to promote skill proficiency, empower upward mobility, and unlock opportunities for everyone, everywhere. With offices and partners across Asia, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and the Americas, we deliver nearly 50 million tests annually. Join us in our journey of measuring progress to power human progress worldwide.

  

The People Generalist is a key member of the People Team, responsible for delivering high\-quality, consistent, and efficient operational HR support across the employee lifecycle. Reporting to the People Operations Manager, this role partners closely with People Business Partners and other People team colleagues to ensure the smooth execution of core People processes, compliance with policies and regulations and ensuring an excellent employee experience. The People Generalist provides hands\-on support in all operational areas across the entire employee life cycle including data management, compliance, and offboarding, and offers ad hoc coordination and administrative support as needed.


This role will help support the role out and coordination of key People Team initiatives across ETS. Supporting our team in delivering continuous improvement, efficiencies and streamlining processes where possible.


PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES


* Deliver day\-to\-day People operations (onboarding, offboarding, employee data management, HRIS administration, compliance), ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and collaboration with the wider People Team and relevant subject matter experts.
* Act as a first point of contact for employee queries, providing guidance on People policies, processes, and systems, escalating complex issues as needed.
* Support People Business Partners with operational delivery, including employee relations coordination, performance management, engagement initiatives, and process alignment.
* Maintain accurate employee records and documentation in line with data privacy and compliance requirements; assist with HR reports, analytics, and dashboards, partnering with HRIS and Total Rewards as relevant.
* Coordinate and support the administration of benefits, payroll, and other employee programmes, collaborating with internal and external stakeholders if relevant in your country.
* Support the implementation and communication of People policies, procedures, and initiatives; participate in continuous improvement of People processes and employee experience.
* Provide administrative support for HR projects, audits, compliance activities, and the organisation of People Team events, training, and meetings.
* Foster a culture of self\-service, working with Internal Communications to ensure clear information for employees.
* Partner with stakeholder groups (e.g., IT, Finance, Marketing) to ensure People Team processes are effective, on brand, and aligned.
* Ensure adherence to internal controls, audit requirements, regulatory standards, and agreed SLAs for People Operations
* Remain flexible and adaptable, supporting ad hoc requests and administration or coordination as directed by the People Consulting or Operations group.

  

**Experience and Skills:**
Qualifications:


* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
* 3\+ years' experience in an HR, People Operations, or administrative role, ideally in a fast\-paced or complex environment.
* Experience supporting HR processes such as onboarding, data management, or employee relations is desirable.
* Exposure to HR systems and data management preferred.
* Experience working in a team\-oriented, service\-driven environment.
* Experience working in a global organization is preferred

KNOWLEDGE/SKILLS


* Basic understanding of financial concepts (e.g., budgets, cost drivers) to support HR\-related administration and queries.
* Awareness of business context and priorities to help align day\-to\-day people practices with team needs.
* Ability to accurately handle HR data, maintain records, and assist with basic reporting.
* Recognises issues or patterns in employee or team challenges and knows when to escalate for resolution.
* Developing commercial awareness and understanding of how HR supports business operations.
* Works collaboratively with colleagues across HR and other departments to deliver effective service.
* Supports change initiatives by helping with communications, gathering feedback, and assisting teams through transitions.
* Strong organisational and prioritisation skills; able to manage multiple tasks and respond to urgent needs.
* Practical problem\-solving skills; able to suggest solutions to routine people\-related challenges.
* Demonstrates initiative by using available information, tools and resources to respond to and resolve employee queries, seeking guidance only when necessary, rather than waiting for direct instruction.
* Builds positive relationships with managers and employees, providing responsive and helpful support.
* Assists in the delivery of HR communications and training to support policy awareness and process adoption.
* Looks for opportunities to improve HR processes and employee experience through feedback and observation.
* Supports HR projects and programmes through coordination and administration.
* Contributes to the documentation and improvement of HR processes and tools.


EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE

description:
**Role description** **Job Title: Procurement Platform Operations \& Integration Analyst**



We are seeking a **Procurement Platform Operations \& Integration Analyst** to support, enhance, and scale a modern Procure\-to\-Pay (P2P) platform. This role focuses on platform operations, production support, system integrations, workflow orchestration, troubleshooting, and intelligent automation initiatives rather than traditional procurement operations.



The ideal candidate will play a key role in supporting an AI\-enabled procurement technology ecosystem by ensuring platform stability, resolving operational issues, implementing integrations, and driving continuous improvements.


**Key Responsibilities**


### **Procurement Platform Operations**


* Manage day\-to\-day platform operations and production support.
* Investigate workflow failures, approval bottlenecks, and transaction issues.
* Perform root cause analysis and resolve production incidents.
* Support platform enhancements, upgrades, configurations, and feature releases.
* Ensure platform reliability, performance, and operational excellence.

### **Integration \& Automation**


* Design, configure, support, and troubleshoot integrations between procurement platforms and enterprise applications.
* Build and maintain API\-based integrations.
* Support integrations with ERP systems, CLM platforms, cloud applications, AWS services, MuleSoft, GenAI platforms, and third\-party SaaS applications.
* Support workflow orchestration and automation initiatives.

### **Troubleshooting \& Support**


* Analyze and resolve issues across procurement workflows, approvals, transactions, and integrations.
* Investigate end\-to\-end process failures across interconnected enterprise systems.
* Collaborate with business and technical teams to drive timely issue resolution.

### **Data \& Analytics**


* Support operational reporting, data extraction, and platform analytics.
* Assist in monitoring platform performance and identifying improvement opportunities.

### **AI \& Intelligent Automation**


* Support AI\-enabled workflows, GenAI integrations, and intelligent automation initiatives.
* Contribute to the continuous evolution of AI\-driven procurement operations.


**Must Have**


* 4–8 years of experience supporting enterprise SaaS applications or procurement technology platforms.
* Strong understanding of Procure\-to\-Pay (P2P) processes and procurement technology ecosystems.
* Experience supporting modern SaaS platforms such as procurement, finance, HR, expense management, or similar enterprise applications.
* Hands\-on experience with REST APIs and enterprise system integrations.
* Experience working with integration platforms such as MuleSoft or similar middleware solutions.
* Exposure to cloud platforms such as AWS.
* Strong troubleshooting, production support, and root cause analysis skills.
* Experience investigating workflow failures, approval issues, and transaction processing problems.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to work independently in a fast\-paced, evolving environment.


**Good to Have**

We are seeking Analyst (Finance) to join our Shared Services FP\&A/Management Reporting team, responsible to maintain and ensure accurate and timely financial reporting. This position will support Shared Services finance operations by managing expense research and reclasses, accruals, prepaids, amortization, balance sheet reconciliations, budgeting, forecasting, and allocation support. The role partners closely with Accounting, Accounts Payable, Shared Services FP\&A, and business stakeholders to ensure accurate financial reporting, budget alignment, and timely month\-end close activities.  



This role involves handling confidential financial information and requires strong coordination across Finance, Operations, Compliance, Legal, HR, and Strategy teams.  


**Key Responsibilities:**
**Expense Research \& Reclasses**
* Act as a point of contact for expense\-related queries from business operations teams.
* Research expense issues, identify root causes, and provide findings back to stakeholders.
* Coordinate with source teams (AP, Telecom, Accounting) to correct expense coding.
* Identify appropriate cost centers and prepare journal entries for expense reclasses.
* Manage and track expense requests through to closure using a structured queue/inbox approach.

  


**Accruals, Prepaids \& Balance Sheet Reconciliations**
* Monitor monthly accruals in partnership with Accounting and AP teams.
* Track and manage prepaids and amortization schedules.
* Support balance sheet reconciliations in line with GAAP requirements.
* Review accuracy of accruals post\-close and highlight variances.
* Assist with transition of accrual monitoring responsibilities from accounting.

  


**Labor Reclasses \& Budget Alignment**
* Prepare monthly labor and cost reclass journal entries to align actuals with approved budgets.
* Support business areas where costs need to be shifted or corrected post\-close.
* Ensure reclasses are well\-documented and auditable.


**Budgeting Support**
* Partner with Shared Services FP\&A to learn and operate the budgeting tool.
* Support budget preparation, uploads, and reconciliations across supported functions.
* Coordinate with Finance Managers to ensure timely and accurate budget submissions.

  


**Forecasting \& Reporting**
* Prepare monthly forecasts for assigned divisions.
* Review forecasts with Shared Services FP\&A analysts prior to submission.
* Support submission of forecasts to Central Shared Services teams as per workday timelines
* Assist with variance analysis and forecast commentary.

  


**Allocations \& Systems Support**
* Act as backup support for shared services allocation processes.
* Assist with preparation and review of allocation true\-ups.
* Support budgeting governance, financial models, reconciliations, and system updates.
* Contribute to Power BI (PBI) refreshes and preparation of insights and narratives.


**Continuous Improvement \& Transition Support**
* Support transition of additional Shared Services divisions as scope expands.
* Assist with capital labor reconciliations as required.
* Identify opportunities for process standardization and efficiency improvements.
* Work closely with the global stakeholders to process and ensure accurate recording (Accruals, Amortization, Allocation, Reclass, etc), reporting, consolidation and analyzing reports pertaining to General ledger accounting
* Active participation in performing the monthly, quarterly, and annual closing process.
* Extract, modify and analyze monthly reports as required and resolve queries.
* Perform General ledger related audit deliverables during audit.
* Periodic updation of SOP's to make sure any process changes, exceptions and new learnings are updated timely.

  


**Key Stakeholders**
* Shared Services FP\&A
* Accounting \& Accounts Payable
* Business Operations (Finance, Compliance, Marketing, Legal, HR, Strategy, IT)
* Central Shared Services Finance Teams

  


**Skills \& Qualifications:**  


**Education:** Preferably CMA / MBA / M.com / Semi qualified with 2 to 4 years (or) CA / CPA with 1 to 2 years of experience in General ledger accounting  


**Technical Skills:**
* Strong understanding of accounting fundamentals (accruals, prepaids, amortization).
* Experience with journal entries, reconciliations, and month\-end close activities.
* Exposure to budgeting and forecasting processes.
* Strong Excel skills (Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP, Macros, VBA preferred); experience with financial systems/tools preferred.
* High attention to detail and ability to manage confidential information.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Experience with Power BI for data uploading and reporting.

title: Senior Human Resources Manager
description:
**Earning a living should never cost a life.** 




  





 That's why Duratuf exists — and the one thing that limits how fast we grow is how fast we hire the right people.
 **That's your seat.** 




  





**About Duratuf** 




 We're an industrial safety company in Kolkata, with our own office and warehouse in the UAE. Our equipment keeps workers safe at 4,142\+ customers across 65\+ countries — when it works, someone gets to go home to their family. We're on our way to 10,000 protected workplaces by 2035\.
 



  





**The Role** 




 You'll build and run our whole People \& Culture function — starting from almost nothing — and turn People into one of the company's real strengths. This is a hands\-on leadership job: senior enough to design the system, close enough to still hire a key person yourself. You'll report to the CEO and own the result, not a task list.
 



  





**What you'll own, end to end:** 



* **Hiring** 
 — build the pipeline, the process, and our name as an employer, so the founders don't have to find people themselves.
* **HR Operations \& Compliance** 
 — keep our HR system clean and current, handle payroll inputs and legal compliance (PF, ESI, POSH), and give every new hire a smooth start.
* **Performance** 
 — set clear goals, run the review cycle, and work with the founders to help every person do their best.
* **Culture \& Engagement** 
 — bring our values to life, keep a pulse on how people feel, and keep attrition low.
* **Learning \& AI** 
 — set up onboarding, run regular training, and get the team using AI in daily work.
* **People \& Team** 
 — plan ahead for hiring, advise the CEO, and build and lead a small People team of 3–5 that grows with the company.



  





**What Success Looks Like** 



* 25\+ roles closed this year, all top\-quality hires
* HR system clean and current, every offer letter out within 48 hours
* Every employee working to clear quarterly goals, with the first full review cycle done on time
* First engagement survey run with 80%\+ taking part, and attrition held at 15% or below
* Proper onboarding for every hire, AI used across the company, and a quarterly training calendar delivered



  





**Must Have** 



* **You've led and scaled** 
**8–12 years in HR** 
 , with at least 3–4 years leading a team and helped grow a company's headcount.
* **A hiring track record you can prove** 
 — specific people you've hired, with titles and dates, including a senior role you closed yourself.
* **You've built, not maintained** 
 — set up an HR function from scratch.
* **All\-round HR judgment** 
 — operations, compliance, performance, and culture, not just one part.
* **You know your numbers** 
 — time\-to\-fill, offer acceptance, and attrition, off the top of your head.
* **You're in Kolkata** 
 , or can move here within 30 days.



  





**Good to Have** 



* Structured hiring methods — scorecards and proper reference checks
* Experience running a company on a system like Scaling Up, EOS, or OKRs
* Business sense — you read the commercial side, not just the people side
* AI in your work today — you can show a real way you use it, not just talk about it



  





**Why Join Duratuf** 



* **Work that matters** 
 — a mission you can point to without a slide
* **Global exposure without leaving Kolkata** 
 — 65\+ markets, our own UAE entity
* **AI\-first, genuinely** 
 — a paid Claude account from Day 1, AI on every req
* **Discipline, not chaos** 
 — we run on Scaling Up: quarterly priorities, weekly rhythms
* **You build it** 
 — the engine you create becomes the backbone of a much bigger team



  





 We hire on values, not just skill — Disciplined Execution · Us Before I · Result Oriented · Inclusive Collaboration · Always Innovating · Numbers that Matter.
 



  





 How We Hire
 



 Simple, fair, and fast — a first call, a detailed interview with the CEO, a values conversation, and reference checks. Every candidate hears back at every stage.
 



**Apply — let's talk.**
